记忆、经验与持久知识
评价器、奖励与自纠正

世界模型与具身适应

title.en: Safety and future risk in agent self-evolution

title.zh: 面向离散智能体更新的冻结非参数行为散度信赖域
title.en: Frozen Non-Parametric Behavioral-Divergence Trust Region for Discrete Agent Updates

problem.zh: 通过预先预测有害的行为分布漂移来决定接纳哪些候选智能体更新，使用简单、冻结、非参数的行为散度门控，而非学习型或多组件信赖域。
problem.en: Decide which candidate agent updates to admit by predicting harmful behavioral distribution shifts before they cause downstream regressions, using a simple, frozen, non-parametric behavioral-divergence gate rather than a learned or multi-component trust region.

hypothesis.zh: 行为偏移应比文本编辑距离或当前任务收益更好预测回退。
hypothesis.en: Behavioral shift should predict regressions better than textual edit distance or current-task gain.

mechanism.zh: 采用单一非参数更新面：冻结的探针套件、由执行轨迹计算的预定义行为散度估计量（经验动作/工具路由分布）以及固定的接纳阈值。仅当散度低于阈值时才接纳更新，并在相同预算下将该门控与匹配的仅结果、当前增益和文本编辑门控进行比较。
mechanism.en: Use one non-parametric update surface: a frozen probe suite, a predefined behavioral-divergence estimator computed from execution traces (empirical action/tool-routing distributions), and a fixed acceptance threshold. Admit an update only if its divergence is below the threshold, and compare this gate against matched outcome-only, current-gain, and text-edit gates under identical budgets.

method_logic.zh: 1) 冻结探针任务套件和候选更新集合。2) 在探针套件上运行更新前智能体，得到经验动作/工具路由频率向量。3) 应用每个候选更新，在同一探针套件上运行更新后智能体，并计算预定义的非参数散度（例如经验动作频率向量之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度）。4) 在单独的构建集上校准单一接纳阈值并冻结。5) 在留出任务上，使用相同的更新池、探针执行、评估任务、调用次数、token 数和墙钟时间，比较行为散度门控与仅结果、当前增益和文本编辑门控在回归检测精度/AUROC 上的表现。
method_logic.en: 1) Freeze a probe suite of tasks and a set of candidate updates. 2) Run the pre-update agent on the probe suite to obtain empirical action/tool-routing frequency vectors. 3) Apply each candidate update, run the post-update agent on the same probe suite, and compute a predefined non-parametric divergence (e.g., Jensen-Shannon divergence between empirical action-frequency vectors). 4) Calibrate a single acceptance threshold on a separate construction set and freeze it. 5) On held-out tasks, compare the behavioral-divergence gate against outcome-only, current-gain, and text-edit gates for regression-detection precision/AUROC, using identical update pools, probe executions, evaluation tasks, calls, tokens, and wall-clock.

novelty_boundary.zh: 与 Retroformer 不同，后者学习回溯模型以改进未来轨迹，而本工作使用无学习组件的非参数散度门控。与 TRPO 不同，后者在连续 RL 的优化过程中通过 KL 信赖域约束策略更新，而本工作在离散智能体更新（补丁）被提出后、而非基于梯度的策略优化过程中，应用冻结的行为散度门控。与安全策略改进不同，后者通常依赖基于结果或回报的保证，而本工作检验纯行为散度信号是否能在仅结果、当前增益和文本编辑门控之外提供额外的预测价值。
novelty_boundary.en: Unlike Retroformer, which learns a retrospective model to improve future trajectories, this work uses a non-parametric divergence gate with no learned components. Unlike TRPO, which constrains policy updates in continuous RL via a KL trust region during optimization, this work applies a frozen behavioral-divergence gate to discrete agent updates (patches) after they are proposed, not during gradient-based policy optimization. Unlike Safe Policy Improvement, which typically relies on outcome-based or return-based guarantees, this work tests whether a purely behavioral-divergence signal adds predictive value beyond outcome-only, current-gain, and text-edit gates.

strongest_baseline.zh: 当前任务收益门控与等预算行为漂移/回归基线。
strongest_baseline.en: Current-task-gain gating and matched-budget behavior-drift/regression controls.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 保留 A-1 已运行的 P0 artifact 与后续诊断，不重写历史实验。
minimum_falsifier.en: Preserve the executed A-1 P0 artifact and later diagnostics without rewriting history.

decision_reason.zh: A-1 会诊后的 soft-audit repair F0 已收口。只用 36 个 development unit 选 horizon，在 36 个 future_eval unit 冻结验证：branch h=1 召回 2/5 nonzero=40%，成本 624/2813=22.2%；更简单的 development target-family prior 在更低成本 613 steps 下召回 3/5=60%，而 h=1 + navigate→navigate trigger 同为 40% recall 但只需 526 steps。进一步 rescue 也失败：获取完整 first-divergence signature 本身需 236 steps；在同 624-step 总预算下，state_signature 与 target_state_signature 排序都仍只召回 2/5=40%，没有超过 target-family prior。future 仅 1 个 harmful unit，不足以授权 harm-prioritization 主张。决定 STOP_REPAIR_SOFT_AUDIT_SIMPLE_TRIAGE_DOMINATES：早期 branch signal 仅并入科研系统的 soft audit scheduling heuristic，不再为 A-1 standalone repair 消耗 GPU。
decision_reason.en: The post-clinic A-1 soft-audit repair F0 is closed. Horizon selection used only 36 development units and was frozen on 36 future_eval units. Branch h=1 recalls 2/5 nonzero effects (40%) at 624/2813 paired-action steps (22.2%). A simpler development target-family prior recalls 3/5 (60%) at a lower 613-step cost, while an h=1 + navigate-to-navigate trigger matches 40% recall at only 526 steps. A final context-signature rescue also fails: acquiring all first-divergence signatures costs 236 steps, and under the same 624-step total budget both state_signature and target_state_signature ranking still recall only 2/5 (40%), below the target-family prior. The future split contains only one harmful unit, so a harm-prioritization claim is not identifiable. Decision: STOP_REPAIR_SOFT_AUDIT_SIMPLE_TRIAGE_DOMINATES. Keep early branch signals only as a research-system soft-audit scheduling heuristic and spend no further GPU on standalone A-1 repair.

reopen_condition.en: merge/drop review; no GPU rerun

title.zh: 预算感知进化控制器

problem.zh: 固定反思和更新轮数会在简单任务浪费调用，在困难任务过早停止。
problem.en: Fixed evolution rounds waste calls on easy tasks and stop too early on difficult ones.

hypothesis.zh: 控制器应在等效性能下减少至少 30% 调用，并能跨任务族迁移。
hypothesis.en: The controller should save at least 30% of calls at matched utility and transfer across task families.

mechanism.zh: 学习一个小型元控制器，根据边际收益、分歧、回退和成本选择继续、回滚或停止。
mechanism.en: Learn a small meta-controller that chooses continue, roll back, or stop from marginal gain, disagreement, regression, and cost.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“学习一个小型元控制器，根据边际收益、分歧、回退和成本选择继续、回滚或停止。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Learn a small meta-controller that chooses continue, roll back, or stop from marginal gain, disagreement, regression, and cost., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

novelty_boundary.zh: 现有 Agent 搜索通常固定预算或 patience，停止规则没有被当作学习对象。
novelty_boundary.en: Agent search usually fixes budgets or patience; stopping itself is rarely treated as a learning problem.

strongest_baseline.zh: 同成功容差下的 fixed-1/fixed-2/fixed-4 与 tuned heuristic。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed-1/fixed-2/fixed-4 and tuned heuristic under the same success tolerance.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 旧 P0 artifact 作为诊断证据保留；重跑先证明 target variation 与 base-agent competence。
minimum_falsifier.en: Keep the old P0 artifact as diagnostic evidence; a rerun must first establish target variation and base-agent competence.

decision_reason.zh: A-2 已从“控制 update round”修到“控制 evidence acquisition depth”并完成 CPU repair F0。development-only 搜索得到 per-target-family horizon 策略，在 development 达到 5/6=83.3% nonzero recall、34.3% cost；但冻结 future_eval 上只剩 2/5=40% recall、734/2813=26.1% cost。继续穷举事前可见 conditioning 后，target-family/source-family/source→target relation 三种 adaptive policy 在 future 都只有 2/5=40% recall，成本分别 26.1%/36.9%/43.9%；完全不自适应的 fixed h=1 同样 2/5=40% recall，却只需 624/2813=22.2% cost，逐项严格支配。决定 STOP_REPAIR_FIXED_HORIZON_DOMINATES：evidence-depth scheduling 并入 A-1/系统 soft audit，不启动 A-2 controller GPU training。
decision_reason.en: A-2 was repaired from controlling update rounds to controlling evidence-acquisition depth and completed a CPU repair F0. A development-only per-target-family horizon search reaches 5/6 (83.3%) nonzero recall at 34.3% cost on development, but on frozen future_eval it falls to 2/5 (40%) recall at 734/2813 steps (26.1%). Exhausting the pre-observable conditioning choices does not rescue it: target-family, source-family, and source-to-target-relation adaptive policies all reach only 2/5 (40%) future recall at 26.1%, 36.9%, and 43.9% cost respectively. A non-adaptive fixed h=1 reaches the same 2/5 (40%) future recall at only 624/2813 steps (22.2%), strictly dominating every adaptive variant. Decision: STOP_REPAIR_FIXED_HORIZON_DOMINATES. Merge evidence-depth scheduling into A-1/system soft audit and do not launch A-2 controller GPU training.

reopen_condition.en: merge/drop review; no GPU rerun

title.zh: 预算校准的预测性回归面板

problem.zh: 预提交 gate 已经成为自进化 Agent 的直接研究对象；剩下的问题不是再叠一个 critic，而是在固定很小的 Probe 预算下，哪些 Probe 真能预测隐藏原任务回退，以及它们何时应该退役。
problem.en: Pre-commit gating is now a direct research topic in self-evolving agents. The remaining problem is not adding another critic, but learning which probes actually predict hidden original-task regression under a fixed small budget and when those probes should retire.

hypothesis.zh: 固定预算下，回归门控应提高未来任务收益并显著降低最坏回退率。
hypothesis.en: Under fixed budgets, regression gating should improve future-task utility and reduce worst-case regression.

mechanism.zh: 维护固定 K 的 core/reserve Probe 面板。用历史已提交/拒绝更新在独立隐藏原任务上的真实 before/after 回退，学习每个 Probe 的预测价值和冗余度；每个 epoch 只允许少量 reserve 替换低价值 core Probe，并用序贯停止决定何时已经收集到足够证据。
mechanism.en: Maintain a fixed-K core/reserve probe panel. Use true before/after regression on independent hidden original tasks from past accepted/rejected updates to learn each probe's predictive value and redundancy; at each epoch only a few reserve probes may replace low-value core probes, with sequential stopping when enough evidence is collected.

method_logic.zh: 1) 冻结候选更新流和隐藏原任务；2) 记录每个 Probe 对每次历史更新的 paired before/after 变化；3) 用隐藏原任务是否真实回退监督 Probe 的 predictive utility，并惩罚 Probe 间冗余；4) 固定 K，分 core/reserve；5) 每个 epoch 只替换低 utility core；6) 新更新只看当前面板并序贯停止；7) 面板策略在第二更新表面前冻结。
method_logic.en: 1) Freeze the candidate-update stream and hidden original tasks; 2) record paired before/after changes for every probe on past updates; 3) supervise probe predictive utility with true hidden-task regression while penalizing redundancy; 4) keep fixed K with core/reserve pools; 5) replace only low-utility core probes each epoch; 6) gate new updates with the current panel and sequential stopping; 7) freeze the panel policy before a second update surface.

novelty_boundary.zh: 2026-08-06 的 Verifier-as-Gatekeeper 已直接证明 skill admission 需要 pre-commit gate，因此 novelty 不能再是‘提交前检查’或‘多 critic’。本方向只保留固定预算下可学习 Probe fidelity/lifecycle 这一变量。
novelty_boundary.en: Verifier-as-Gatekeeper (2026-08-06) directly establishes pre-commit skill gating, so novelty cannot be pre-commit checking or multiple critics. The surviving variable is learnable probe fidelity/lifecycle under a fixed budget.

strongest_baseline.zh: historical-sensitivity ranking + 相同 K 的 fixed stopping；fixed VaG-style gate。
strongest_baseline.en: Historical-sensitivity ranking plus fixed stopping at the same K; fixed VaG-style gate.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 跨版本 discovery/calibration 后冻结 core/reserve；隐藏原任务同时评估 accepted/rejected updates 的 fidelity、false-safe 与成本。
minimum_falsifier.en: Freeze core/reserve after cross-version discovery/calibration; evaluate hidden-original fidelity, false-safe rate, and cost for both accepted and rejected updates.

decision_reason.zh: A-3 当前 prompt-patch P0 实例已触发 substrate STOP：8 个 typed/scoped candidate 仅 1 个正 target gain，effective candidate fraction=12.5%<冻结 40% 门；updater competence 为 block-only FAIL。6-task mastered panel 已冻结并通过，但 fresh candidate×panel×hidden-original fidelity 从未获授权执行，hidden original 未打开。因此 STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_UPDATER_INCOMPETENT 只停止当前 Qwen2.5-7B+ALFWorld prompt-patch 实例，不授权 A-3 方法 FAIL；若未来重开必须先换成新通过 competence 的 update substrate/action stream。
decision_reason.en: The current A-3 prompt-patch P0 instance fires a substrate STOP: among 8 typed/scoped candidates only 1 has positive target gain and the effective-candidate fraction is 12.5%, below the frozen 40% gate; updater competence is a block-only failure. The six-task mastered panel is frozen and passed, but the fresh candidate × panel × hidden-original fidelity test was never authorized and hidden originals were never opened. STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_UPDATER_INCOMPETENT therefore stops only the current Qwen2.5-7B + ALFWorld prompt-patch instance and does not authorize an A-3 method failure; reopening requires a newly competence-qualified update substrate/action stream.

reopen_condition.zh: Stop GPU work on this prompt-patch P0 instance. Reopen A-3 only with a newly qualified update substrate/action stream and a newly frozen fresh-candidate validation; otherwise send the direction to human pivot/drop review.
reopen_condition.en: Stop GPU work on this prompt-patch P0 instance. Reopen A-3 only with a newly qualified update substrate/action stream and a newly frozen fresh-candidate validation; otherwise send the direction to human pivot/drop review.

primary_next_action.action_zh: 保持 HOLD；只有满足已记录的重开条件后，才重新进入科学评审。

title.zh: 组合更新兼容性：冻结更新表面、预注册N=12更新与架构匹配消融
title.en: Compositional Update Compatibility with Frozen Update Surface, Preregistered N=12 Updates, and Architecture-Matched Ablation

problem.zh: 解决两个单独有用的更新在组合时可能相互干扰的问题，且个体回归测试无法预测组合结果。
problem.en: Address the problem that two individually useful updates can interfere when composed, and individual regression tests cannot predict composition outcomes.

hypothesis.zh: 交互图应预测未见组合回退并找到更优提交顺序。
hypothesis.en: The interaction graph should predict unseen composition regressions and identify better commit orders.

mechanism.zh: 冻结一组预注册的N=12个原子更新表面，通过架构匹配消融验证显式成对交互特征（输入共享图/关系架构）是否比剥离交互特征但节点/边容量匹配的相同架构更能预测未见过的组合回归。
mechanism.en: Freeze a preregistered set of N=12 atomic update surfaces and verify through architecture-matched ablation whether explicit pairwise interaction features (fed into a shared graph/relational architecture) predict unseen composition regressions better than the same architecture with interaction features stripped but node/edge capacity matched.

method_logic.zh: 1) 预注册并冻结N=12个原子更新：6个提示补丁（P1-P6）和6个工具替换（T1-T6），在任何测量前提交确切规格；2) 在训练集上测量所有132个有序对（12×11）和220个三更新组合的执行结果；3) 使用相同的RelationalGraphEncoder架构训练两个预测器：(a) 显式交互模型接收成对交互特征（顺序交换差异、共现统计）作为边属性，(b) 剥离基线仅接收节点嵌入（更新身份），边属性置零但参数数量相同；4) 在预注册的不相交反向对（66对）和三更新（110组合）测试上评估。
method_logic.en: 1) Preregister and freeze N=12 atomic updates: 6 prompt patches (P1-P6) and 6 tool replacements (T1-T6), with exact specifications committed before any measurement; 2) Measure execution outcomes for all 132 ordered pairs (12×11) and 220 three-update combinations on training set; 3) Train two predictors using identical RelationalGraphEncoder architecture: (a) explicit interaction model receives pairwise interaction features (order-swap differentials, co-occurrence statistics) as edge attributes, (b) stripped baseline receives only node embeddings (update identity) with edge attributes zeroed but same parameter count; 4) Evaluate on preregistered disjoint reversed-pair (66 pairs) and three-update (110 combinations) tests.

novelty_boundary.zh: 与Flow、AFlow和软件合并测试的区别：本工作不关注工作流搜索或代码合并冲突检测，而是专注于学习预测任意更新组合（包括未见过的顺序）的干扰，且通过架构匹配消融严格分离表示结构的贡献。
novelty_boundary.en: Distinct from Flow, AFlow, and Software Merge Testing: this work does not focus on workflow search or code merge conflict detection, but on learning to predict interference for arbitrary update compositions (including unseen orders), with strict separation of representational contribution via architecture-matched ablation.

strongest_baseline.zh: set-conditioned order-aware risk model + equal-budget constrained repair search。
strongest_baseline.en: Set-conditioned order-aware risk model plus equal-budget constrained repair search.

minimum_falsifier.zh: held-out update identities 与 held-out template×surface compositions 上直接预测并 zero-search 修复。
minimum_falsifier.en: Directly predict and repair on held-out update identities and held-out template×surface compositions with zero test-time search.

decision_reason.zh: A-4 CPU P0 已触发 frozen matched-simplification STOP：用同一 15 条 typed pair/order intervention table，registry 编译 no-good / precedence / compatibility clauses；matched baseline 只存 ordered descriptor pair 风险表，并在 hidden triple 上做 equal-budget local constrained repair。20 个 held-out triples、全部 update identities 未见，双方 prediction accuracy=1.0、repair success=1.0、逐 case repair agreement=1.0，candidate checks 49 vs 49。typed registry 没有提供超出 direct order-aware risk + repair 的独立价值，建议 merge/drop，等待人工确认。
decision_reason.en: A-4 CPU P0 fired the frozen matched-simplification STOP. From the same 15 typed pair/order intervention rows, the registry compiles no-good/precedence/compatibility clauses while the matched baseline stores only an ordered descriptor-pair risk table and performs equal-budget local constrained repair on hidden triples. Across 20 held-out triples with entirely unseen update identities, both reach prediction accuracy=1.0, repair success=1.0, exact per-case repair agreement=1.0, and 49 vs 49 candidate checks. The typed registry adds no standalone value beyond direct order-aware risk plus repair; recommend merge/drop pending human review.

reopen_condition.zh: Merge A-4 into a direct ordered-composition risk/repair baseline; the typed registry adds no held-out prediction or repair value.
reopen_condition.en: Merge A-4 into a direct ordered-composition risk/repair baseline; the typed registry adds no held-out prediction or repair value.

title.zh: 回滚等价的更新历史压缩

problem.zh: 版本化 rollback 已出现更直接的 Agent memory 系统，OS 层也已有高效增量 checkpoint/rollback；当前版本不再具备直接进入 P0 的新颖性边界。只有证明跨异构更新表面的固定存储预算行为等价压缩不能被 snapshot/delta checkpoint 解决，才值得复活。
problem.en: Direct agent-memory version control and efficient incremental checkpoint/rollback now exist. The current version is no longer P0-ready and is revivable only if cross-surface behavioral-equivalent compaction under a fixed storage budget cannot be solved by snapshot/delta checkpointing.

hypothesis.zh: 局部回滚应比恢复最近 checkpoint 保留更多累积收益。
hypothesis.en: Local rollback should preserve more accumulated gain than reverting to the latest checkpoint.

mechanism.zh: 定期把顺序更新链压成 checkpoint + dependency/restoration clauses。压缩目标不是重构参数相似度，而是对一组冻结 rollback query 保持行为等价：撤销任意授权更新子集后，压缩历史应恢复与 full-history replay 相同的任务行为。
mechanism.en: Periodically compress sequential update history into checkpoints plus dependency/restoration clauses. The objective is not parameter similarity but behavioral rollback equivalence: for frozen rollback queries, undoing authorized update subsets should match full-history replay behavior.

method_logic.zh: 1) 顺序记录更新和小型影响签名；2) 用 disable/replay 在 discovery rollback queries 上估计依赖；3) 压缩为周期 checkpoint + sparse dependency/restoration clauses；4) 冻结 compactor；5) 在未见 rollback queries 上恢复；6) full history 仅作为 oracle，不参与压缩训练。
method_logic.en: 1) Record sequential updates and compact influence signatures; 2) estimate dependencies with disable/replay on discovery rollback queries; 3) compact into periodic checkpoints plus sparse dependency/restoration clauses; 4) freeze the compactor; 5) recover unseen rollback queries; 6) full history is an oracle only, not a training shortcut.

novelty_boundary.zh: MemoRepair 已解决 provenance 完整时的 descendant cascade repair，CleanEdit/顺序编辑工作也处理 harmful edit maintenance；本方向只保留‘在固定存储预算下保持未来 rollback 行为等价’这一压缩问题。
novelty_boundary.en: MemoRepair handles descendant cascade repair with complete provenance, while CleanEdit and sequential editing methods maintain harmful edits. The surviving problem is preserving future rollback behavioral equivalence under a fixed storage budget.

strongest_baseline.zh: 相同 storage/replay budget 的 periodic checkpoints。
strongest_baseline.en: Periodic checkpoints at matched storage/replay budget.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 30–50 sequential updates + 12 frozen rollback queries，测 rollback fidelity、accumulated gain 与压缩率。
minimum_falsifier.en: 30–50 sequential updates plus 12 frozen rollback queries measuring rollback fidelity, accumulated gain, and compaction.

decision_reason.en: A-5 CPU P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP. Across 40 sequential updates and 12 frozen rollback queries, the semantic compactor and a query-matched generic state-diff baseline both achieve 12/12 rollback fidelity=1.0 with identical 6.5 mean replay segments. The generic baseline uses no Prompt/Memory/Workflow semantics and needs only 38 storage cells versus 73 for semantic compaction. A periodic-checkpoint baseline at roughly the same 72-cell budget also achieves 12/12 and replays only 2.25 updates on average. Agent-specific semantic history compaction has no standalone advantage and should merge into generic version/state-diff infrastructure pending human merge/drop review.

title.zh: 跨过程验证经验蒸馏

problem.zh: 多条成功轨迹做交集、共识或 contrast 已经不足以形成新方法；真正的问题是：同一成功结果可由不同有效过程获得时，哪条经验在改变未来行为后仍跨过程稳定有益。
problem.en: Intersection, consensus, or contrast over multiple successful trajectories is no longer enough. The real problem is identifying lessons whose behavioral intervention remains beneficial across distinct valid processes that reach the same successful outcome.

hypothesis.zh: 跨成功过程稳定的经验应比单轨迹反思具有更强圈外迁移。
hypothesis.en: Lessons stable across successful processes should transfer better than single-trajectory reflections.

mechanism.zh: 冻结同一任务、同一成功终点的多种 process family。一个冻结 extractor 从每条成功轨迹提 candidate lesson；随后对 lesson 做 memory-OFF / memory-ON matched intervention，并采用 leave-one-process-family-out 验证。只有平均效用为正、worst-process 不为负且跨 process 方差低的 lesson 才持久写入。
mechanism.en: Freeze multiple process families for the same task and same successful outcome. A frozen extractor proposes candidate lessons from each success; each lesson then receives matched memory-OFF/memory-ON interventions with leave-one-process-family-out validation. Persist only lessons with positive mean utility, non-negative worst-process effect, and low cross-process variance.

method_logic.zh: 1) 固定 task/outcome，按 action/tool graph 划分 3–4 个有效 process family；2) 冻结 extractor 和候选 lesson；3) 每个 lesson 的生成 family 与验证 family 严格分离；4) 在相同 future-task pool 上做 memory OFF/ON paired replay；5) 估计 mean、worst-process 和 effect variance；6) 只晋升跨过程效用稳定 lesson；7) 测试时直接复用，不再做多轨迹推理。
method_logic.en: 1) Fix task/outcome and partition 3–4 valid process families by action/tool graph; 2) freeze extractor and candidate lessons; 3) separate lesson-generation families from validation families; 4) run memory OFF/ON paired replay on the same future-task pool; 5) estimate mean, worst-process, and effect variance; 6) promote only cross-process stable lessons; 7) reuse directly at test time with no multi-trajectory reasoning.

novelty_boundary.zh: SkillCAT 已对同任务多轨迹做 contrastive extraction，Trace2Skill 与 ACL 2026 memory survey 已覆盖 cross-trajectory abstraction，Mem2Evolve/ReMe 已做经验蒸馏与 utility refinement。因此只保留‘同 outcome 不同过程下的干预效用不变性’这一独立变量。
novelty_boundary.en: SkillCAT contrasts same-task trajectories; Trace2Skill and the ACL 2026 memory survey cover cross-trajectory abstraction; Mem2Evolve/ReMe cover experience distillation and utility refinement. The surviving variable is intervention-utility invariance across different valid processes with the same outcome.

strongest_baseline.zh: Utility-only admission：同 candidate lesson、同 memory-on/off replay 数、同 future tasks，只按跨所有轨迹的平均效用排序，不区分 process family。
strongest_baseline.en: Utility-only admission: same candidate lessons, memory-on/off replay count, and future tasks, ranked by mean utility across all trajectories without process-family structure.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 每个 discovery task 收集至少 3 个成功 process family；冻结 20–30 个 candidate lesson。四臂比较 single-success、consensus、utility-only、cross-process validated，memory 数量和 replay 预算严格匹配。
minimum_falsifier.en: Collect at least three successful process families per discovery task and freeze 20–30 candidate lessons. Compare single-success, consensus, utility-only, and cross-process validated arms with matched memory count and replay budget.

decision_reason.zh: 真实实验为 matched-simplification-tie，hidden effect≈0.0139；same-outcome process invariance 不再独立成论文。
decision_reason.en: Real experiments produced a matched-simplification tie with hidden effect ≈0.0139; same-outcome process invariance is no longer standalone.

title.zh: 固定容量下基于交叉删除干预的保留矛盾记忆巩固
title.en: Contradiction-Preserving Memory Consolidation under Fixed Capacity with Crossed Deletion Interventions

problem.zh: 解决记忆巩固只保留共识摘要、丢弃可推翻规则的稀有反证的问题：在固定容量下检验“显式保留最小结论改变集”是否比非学习的矛盾感知保留或效用保留更能降低过泛化与后续负迁移。
problem.en: Address the problem that memory consolidation keeps consensus summaries and drops rare counterevidence that can overturn a rule: test, under fixed capacity, whether explicitly retaining a minimal conclusion-changing set reduces overgeneralization and later negative transfer more than non-learned contradiction-aware or utility-based retention.

hypothesis.zh: 保留反证应减少过度概括和后续负迁移。
hypothesis.en: Preserving counterevidence should reduce overgeneralization and later negative transfer.

mechanism.zh: 在固定容量 K 下，用一次性、可 oracle 验证的结论改变探测构建并冻结一个最小结论改变保留集（删除该条目会使至少一个留出探针查询的最终答案翻转），剩余容量用最近条目填充；通过与矛盾感知非学习保留和效用保留在相同记忆/检索/校准预算下的交叉删除干预对比，隔离反证保留的因果效应，并用预注册的非劣效界值 δ 与绑定决策规则直接判定主张存亡。
mechanism.en: Under fixed capacity K, build and freeze a minimal conclusion-changing retention set via one-time oracle-verifiable probes (an entry is conclusion-changing iff removing it flips the final answer of at least one held-out probe query), fill remaining capacity by recency, and isolate the causal effect of counterevidence retention through crossed deletion interventions against contradiction-aware non-learned retention and utility-based retention under identical memory/retrieval/calibration budgets, with a preregistered non-inferiority margin δ and a binding decision rule that directly determines whether the claim survives or dies.

method_logic.zh: （1）在构建集上，对每个候选记忆条目用同一冻结模型与相同提示各运行两次下游任务（含/不含该条目），若任一留出探针查询最终答案改变则标记为结论改变；（2）按“先保留全部结论改变条目、再以最近条目填满容量 K”生成冻结记忆缓冲，评估前锁定，不在测试时重学；（3）评估时施加交叉删除算子：删结论改变条目、删等量随机非结论改变条目、删最旧条目、不删除；（4）与矛盾感知非学习保留、效用保留在相同预算下对比结论稳定性、未来任务收益、最坏回归与更新准入精度；（5）校准预算匹配：矛盾感知基线获得与 oracle 校准相同的 token/调用预算用于其 NLI 启发式选择（对每个候选条目运行相同次数的前向传播，只是用 NLI 打分替代结论改变判定）；若无法匹配，则将 oracle 校准成本显式计入每条件总预算，并在结果中单独报告“校准成本调整后”的净收益；（6）预注册非劣效界值 δ：在两个模型×两个领域共 4 个条件中，若 oracle 结论改变保留在至少 3 个条件上的最坏回归优于矛盾感知基线的幅度不超过 δ=2 个百分点（绝对差），则判定主张不成立。
method_logic.en: (1) On a construction set, run the downstream task twice per candidate entry (with/without it) using the same frozen model and identical prompts; mark an entry conclusion-changing if any held-out probe query's final answer flips. (2) Build the frozen memory buffer by admitting all conclusion-changing entries first, then filling capacity K with the most recent entries; lock before evaluation with no test-time relearning. (3) At evaluation, apply crossed deletion operators: drop conclusion-changing entries, drop an equal number of random non-conclusion-changing entries, drop oldest entries, or no deletion. (4) Compare against contradiction-aware non-learned retention and utility-based retention under identical budgets on conclusion stability, future-task gain, worst-case regression, and update-admission precision. (5) Calibration budget matching: the contradiction-aware baseline receives an identical token/call budget for its NLI-heuristic selection (same number of forward passes per candidate entry, with NLI scoring replacing conclusion-change judgment); if matching is impossible, explicitly include oracle calibration cost in each condition's total budget and separately report 'calibration-cost-adjusted' net gain. (6) Preregistered non-inferiority margin δ: across the 2 model × 2 domain = 4 conditions, if oracle conclusion-changing retention does not exceed contradiction-aware retention on worst-case regression by more than δ=2 percentage points (absolute difference) in at least 3 of 4 conditions, the claim is judged dead.

novelty_boundary.zh: 与 Memory Consolidation 的区别：不学习压缩摘要，而是用可验证的结论改变标准做确定性保留选择；与 EvoGraph-R1 的区别：不做图结构演化或梯度更新，持久对象是一次性构建并冻结的保留集；与 Contradiction Retrieval 的区别：不是在检索时检测矛盾，而是在巩固时以“删除是否翻转结论”为准入标准，并用交叉删除干预隔离其因果效应。仅基于给定最近工作上下文，不主张相关文献不存在。
novelty_boundary.en: Versus Memory Consolidation: no learned compressive summarization—retention is a deterministic, verifiable conclusion-change criterion. Versus EvoGraph-R1: no graph-structure evolution or gradient updates—the persistent object is a one-time constructed, frozen retention set. Versus Contradiction Retrieval: contradiction is not detected at retrieval time; admission at consolidation time is based on whether deletion flips a conclusion, with crossed deletion interventions isolating the causal effect. Based only on the supplied nearest-work context; no claim that related literature does not exist.

strongest_baseline.zh: 完全匹配 representative/calibration budget 的 contradiction-aware NLI 与 utility retention。
strongest_baseline.en: Contradiction-aware NLI and utility retention with fully matched representative/calibration budgets.

minimum_falsifier.zh: matched deletion 建立 conclusion-change set，冻结后在 hidden E_orig paired before/after。
minimum_falsifier.en: Build the conclusion-change set with matched deletion, freeze it, then run paired before/after on hidden E_orig.

STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_CONCLUSION_CHANGE_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT stops only this data instance and does not authorize a B-2 method failure; hidden E_orig must remain sealed.

title.zh: 共检索交互排斥图

problem.zh: 单条 memory 的 causal usefulness 已有直接方法；剩下的真实失败是两条单独无害/有益的 memory 同时被检索后相互误导，而 per-item score 看不见这种 interaction。
problem.en: Direct methods already estimate causal usefulness of individual memories. The remaining failure is interaction: two memories may each be harmless or useful alone yet become harmful when co-retrieved, which per-item scores cannot detect.

hypothesis.zh: 隔离识别出的有害条目后，应恢复圈外任务且保留主要收益。
hypothesis.en: Quarantining harmful entries should recover out-of-loop tasks without erasing main gains.

mechanism.zh: 先用 per-item causal selector 得到候选集，再只对高频共检索 pair 做 2×2 intervention：none、A、B、A+B。把‘有害’操作化为：A+B 的真实任务效用相对 none、A 或 B 出现可重复的额外负边际效应；把‘隔离’操作化为：保留原 memory，但写入 exclusion / precedence edge，使该触发条件下不再共同检索或强制先后顺序。最终形成持久 co-retrieval graph，测试时不再额外 replay。
mechanism.en: Start from a per-item causal selector, then run 2×2 interventions only for frequent co-retrieval pairs: none, A, B, A+B. Define harmful operationally as a reproducible extra negative marginal effect of A+B on true task utility relative to none/A/B. Define quarantine as preserving the original memories while storing an exclusion/precedence edge that blocks joint retrieval or enforces order under the trigger. Persist the resulting co-retrieval graph and use it at test time without extra replay.

method_logic.zh: 1) 冻结 per-item selector 与 top-M memory；2) 从真实检索日志筛高频 pair；3) 每个 pair 做 matched 2×2 intervention；4) 用环境/程序真值估计 interaction residual ΔAB−ΔA−ΔB，并要求负效应跨任务重复后才标为 harmful；5) harmful-retrieval 只加 exclusion edge，harmful-order 只加 precedence edge，不默认删除或改写 memory；6) 测试时 graph 只做 exclude/order，不重新 replay。
method_logic.en: 1) Freeze the per-item selector and top-M memories; 2) select frequent pairs from real retrieval logs; 3) run matched 2×2 interventions; 4) estimate interaction residual ΔAB−ΔA−ΔB from environment/program truth and label harm only after the negative effect repeats across tasks; 5) use exclusion edges for harmful co-retrieval and precedence edges for harmful ordering without deleting/rewriting memories by default; 6) at test time the graph only excludes/orders without replay.

novelty_boundary.zh: Causal Memory Intervention 已直接按受控 intervention 选择有用/有害 memory，因此旧三臂 auditor 已碰撞。只保留 per-item causal selection 之后的 co-retrieval interaction residual。
novelty_boundary.en: Causal Memory Intervention already selects useful/harmful memories via controlled interventions, colliding with the old auditor. The surviving variable is co-retrieval interaction residual after per-item causal selection.

strongest_baseline.zh: per-item causal selector + simple co-occurrence exclusion，matched audit cost。
strongest_baseline.en: Per-item causal selector plus simple co-occurrence exclusion at matched audit cost.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 定位路径后做持久修复，冻结后在 future reuse 上评估净收益与干预样本效率。
minimum_falsifier.en: Apply persistent repair after pathway localization, then freeze and evaluate future-reuse net benefit and intervention sample efficiency.

decision_reason.zh: B-3 synthetic matched-cost screening 曾给出 pathway signal，但真实 fresh reality gate 的 substrate support 不足：先前 v1 的 6 targets 中 5/6 与旧 Memory full-support target scenarios 重叠，已标 INVALID_TARGET_OVERLAP_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY 并停止；按严格 fresh contract 排除 source scenarios、全部旧 target scenarios 与重复 target 后，四个 source family 仅剩 0/3/1/1，共 5 个 executable fresh scenarios < 冻结 6-pair gate。触发 STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_FRESH_CINTERACTION_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT；不授权 B-3 方法 FAIL。
decision_reason.en: B-3 synthetic matched-cost screening produced a pathway signal, but the real fresh-reality substrate lacks support. Five of six targets in the first v1 run overlapped prior Memory full-support target scenarios, so that run was marked INVALID_TARGET_OVERLAP_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY and stopped. Under the strict fresh contract excluding source scenarios, all prior target scenarios, and duplicate targets, the four source families expose only 0/3/1/1 = 5 executable fresh scenarios, below the frozen six-pair gate. STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_FRESH_CINTERACTION_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT fires; a B-3 method failure is not authorized.

reopen_condition.en: Stop the current ALFWorld B-3 instance and send it to human pivot/drop review; reopen only on a fresh co-retrieval substrate with at least six independent unseen pair-target units.

title.zh: 影响范围路由的经验准入

problem.zh: generic pre-commit gate 已经有直接工作；memory-specific 方向只剩一个更窄问题：在完全固定的 Probe 数量下，能否利用 lesson 的触发条件与适用范围，把有限 sentinel 预算更准确地分给真正可能受影响的任务。
problem.en: Generic pre-commit gates now have direct prior work. The memory-specific question that remains is whether lesson triggers and applicability scope can route a strictly fixed sentinel budget toward tasks actually likely to be affected.

hypothesis.zh: 同样 replay 预算下，记忆特有的影响范围应比源任务因果门控、语义相似度或通用回归 Probe 更少放入有害经验。
hypothesis.en: At the same replay budget, memory-specific impact scope should admit fewer harmful lessons than source-only causal gating, semantic similarity, or generic regression probes.

mechanism.zh: 每条 lesson 固定只允许 6 个 sentinel。scope router 根据触发条件、检索位置、tool/API 类型和任务结构，分配 2 个预计受影响、2 个边界、2 个预计不受影响任务；做 paired before/after 后才准入。A-3 使用完全相同 6 个 Probe 与真值作为 parent control。
mechanism.en: Each lesson receives exactly six sentinels. A scope router uses trigger conditions, retrieval position, tool/API type, and task structure to allocate two predicted-affected, two boundary, and two predicted-unaffected tasks; admission follows paired before/after testing. A-3 receives the exact same six-probe budget and truth as the parent control.

method_logic.zh: 1) discovery lesson 用真实 before/after 影响拟合轻量 scope router；2) 新 lesson 固定 K=6；3) router 只负责 sentinel 分配，不决定 truth；4) source task + 6 sentinel 做 paired replay；5) 冻结 router 后在未见 task family 测试；6) 同一 6 Probe 交给 A-3 predictive panel 做 parent-merge 对照。
method_logic.en: 1) Fit a lightweight scope router from true before/after influence of discovery lessons; 2) fix K=6 for every new lesson; 3) the router only allocates sentinels and never defines truth; 4) run paired replay on the source task plus six sentinels; 5) freeze before unseen task families; 6) give the same six probes to the A-3 predictive panel for the parent-merge control.

novelty_boundary.zh: VaG 已覆盖 pre-commit skill gate，CMI/ReMe 已覆盖 memory utility；因此 B-4 不能主张 generic causal admission，只剩 memory-specific influence scope 是否能在固定 sentinel 预算下优于 A-3 通用面板。
novelty_boundary.en: VaG covers pre-commit skill gating and CMI/ReMe cover memory utility, so B-4 cannot claim generic causal admission. The only surviving variable is whether memory-specific influence scope beats the A-3 generic panel under a fixed sentinel budget.

strongest_baseline.zh: 相同 6-probe budget 的 A-3 generic regression panel。
strongest_baseline.en: A-3 generic regression panel at the same six-probe budget.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 20–30 个冻结 lesson，6-sentinel 硬预算；比较随机、全局历史敏感度、A-3 learned panel、scope-routed panel。hidden task family 在 router 和阈值冻结后才打开。
minimum_falsifier.en: Use 20–30 frozen lessons with a hard six-sentinel budget; compare random, global historical sensitivity, the A-3 learned panel, and scope-routed selection. Hidden task families open only after router/threshold freeze.

decision_reason.zh: 人工指定并入 A-3；只保留为 ablation/extension/budget-allocation option，不能反向合并。
decision_reason.en: Human review explicitly merges this into A-3; retain it only as an ablation/extension/budget-allocation option and never reverse the merge.

reopen_condition.en: Only new matched primary evidence that overturns the current conclusion may reopen this direction.

title.zh: 最小单调适用边界修复

problem.zh: 遇到反例时整条删除或重写 procedural memory 会损失仍然有效的主体；但 counterexample-driven skill refinement 已有工作，因此新变量必须是‘skill body 完全冻结，只允许 external applicability gate 最小且单调地收缩’。
problem.en: Deleting or rewriting a procedural memory after a counterexample destroys still-valid content. Because counterexample-driven skill refinement already exists, the new variable must be a fully frozen skill body with only a minimally and monotonically shrinking external applicability gate.

hypothesis.zh: 局部修复应同时提高反例修复率和旧正例保持率。
hypothesis.en: Local repair should improve both counterexample repair and old-positive retention.

mechanism.zh: 冻结 skill body 和预定义 predicate vocabulary。每个验证反例只允许向 external gate 增加最小 distinguishing predicate，使该反例被排除；gate 不得重新扩张，且每次收缩都必须通过旧正例保持测试。
mechanism.en: Freeze the skill body and a predefined predicate vocabulary. Each verified counterexample may only add the minimal distinguishing predicate to an external gate that excludes that counterexample; the gate cannot re-expand, and every shrink must preserve old positives.

method_logic.zh: 1) 冻结 skill body/predicate vocabulary；2) verifier 确认 counterexample；3) 搜索能区分反例与旧正例的最小 predicate conjunction；4) 只收缩 applicability gate；5) 每次修复做 old-positive preservation；6) 跨第二 task family 前冻结 gate learner。
method_logic.en: 1) Freeze skill body/predicate vocabulary; 2) verify the counterexample; 3) find the minimal predicate conjunction separating it from old positives; 4) shrink only the applicability gate; 5) test old-positive preservation after every repair; 6) freeze the gate learner before a second task family.

novelty_boundary.zh: CEDAR 已用 counterexample 持续修 skill/formal specification，MemoRepair 已做 provenance cascade repair；因此本方向不主张 counterexample repair 本身，只主张 frozen skill body 下的 minimal monotone applicability shrinkage。
novelty_boundary.en: CEDAR already refines skills/specifications with counterexamples and MemoRepair handles provenance cascade repair. The claim is not counterexample repair itself, only minimal monotone applicability shrinkage around a frozen skill body.

strongest_baseline.zh: complexity-matched ILP 与 precondition-only learner。
strongest_baseline.en: Complexity-matched ILP and precondition-only learner.

title.zh: 复用机会驱动的记忆效用复验

problem.zh: stale memory、utility refinement 和 shift recovery 都已有直接工作；剩下的问题不是‘会不会过期’，而是在固定审计预算下，何时值得重新做一次 memory-on/off 干预来确认局部效用已经漂移。
problem.en: Stale memory, utility refinement, and shift recovery now have direct prior work. The remaining problem is not whether memory becomes stale, but when a fixed audit budget should trigger a new memory-on/off intervention because local utility has drifted.

hypothesis.zh: 基于激活局部效用的复验应在相同审计预算下比 LRU、LFU、固定 TTL 和定期复验更早发现真正失效的记忆，同时少误删长期有效记忆。
hypothesis.en: Activation-local utility revalidation should detect truly stale memories earlier than LRU, LFU, fixed TTL, and periodic revalidation at the same audit budget while deleting fewer durable memories.

mechanism.zh: 采用两阶段触发。第一阶段完全廉价：memory 每次被激活就打标，只用最近使用时间、激活频率、复用间隔和局部 API/schema 变化给所有 memory 排审计优先级；很久没用、局部环境变化大或复用模式异常的 memory 先进入候选。第二阶段才消耗真实预算：只对固定比例候选做 memory-on/off paired replay，用真实边际效用决定继续保留、缩短复验间隔或隔离。历史干预效用只学习‘下一次该审谁’，不替代最终真值。
mechanism.en: Use a two-stage trigger. Stage one is cheap: mark every activation and rank memories for audit using recency, activation frequency, reuse interval, and local API/schema change; long-unused memories, strong local changes, or unusual reuse patterns become candidates. Stage two spends real budget only on a fixed fraction of candidates via paired memory-on/off replay, whose true marginal utility decides retain, shorten the next audit interval, or quarantine. Historical intervention utility learns only whom to audit next and never replaces final truth.

method_logic.zh: 1) 每次 memory 激活时记录 last-used、frequency、reuse interval、task/API/schema/local-state；2) 用这些零额外 Agent 调用的局部性特征形成 cheap trigger/ranking；3) 预注册固定 audit fraction K，只审计排名前 K 或按校准概率抽样的 memory；4) 审计时做 memory OFF/ON paired replay得到真实边际效用；5) 用历史 audit 结果学习下一轮审计调度，但 pruning/quarantine 必须由真实 replay 结果触发；6) shift 前冻结；7) 与 TTL/LRU/LFU/纯 recency+frequency 在完全相同 audit replay 数下比较。
method_logic.en: 1) On each activation record last-used time, frequency, reuse interval, task/API/schema/local state; 2) form a cheap trigger/ranking from these locality features with no extra agent calls; 3) preregister a fixed audit fraction K and audit only top-K or calibrated-sampled memories; 4) obtain true marginal utility with paired memory OFF/ON replay; 5) learn next-round audit scheduling from historical audits, while pruning/quarantine must be triggered by real replay outcomes; 6) freeze before shift; 7) compare with TTL/LRU/LFU/pure recency+frequency using exactly the same audit replay count.

novelty_boundary.zh: ReMe 已做 utility-based memory lifecycle，ShiftBench 已测 shift 后 memory recovery，STALE/StateAuditor 已处理 stale dependency。因此 novelty 只能是同审计预算下、基于 activation-level intervention utility 的复验调度。
novelty_boundary.en: ReMe covers utility-based memory lifecycle, ShiftBench evaluates post-shift recovery, and STALE/StateAuditor addresses stale dependencies. Novelty is limited to activation-level intervention-utility scheduling under the same audit budget.

strongest_baseline.zh: 同一 20% audit/replay budget 的 TTL、LRU、LFU、recency+frequency。
strongest_baseline.en: TTL, LRU, LFU, and recency+frequency under the same 20% audit/replay budget.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 在真实 reuse opportunities 上估 intervention utility drift，冻结后评估 future reuse harm/benefit 与成本。
minimum_falsifier.en: Estimate intervention utility drift at real reuse opportunities, freeze, then evaluate future-reuse harm/benefit and cost.

decision_reason.zh: B-6 CPU P0 已触发更强的 matched-simplification STOP：12 memories×25 reuse opportunities，固定每 5 次 activation 审计一次，严格 20%=60/300 matched ON/OFF labels。learned utility-hazard 在 240 future reuse 上仍漏留 16 个 harmful memory；同一 audit 标签调出的 recency>=4 && frequency<=2 simple rule 为 0 harmful retained、0 beneficial quarantine，保留 benefit 同为 192。simple recency+frequency policy 严格支配 learned hazard，因此只保留 cache/revalidation component，等待人工 merge/drop。
decision_reason.en: B-6 CPU P0 fired a stronger matched-simplification STOP. Across 12 memories × 25 reuse opportunities, every fifth activation is audited, giving exactly 20%=60/300 matched ON/OFF utility labels. On 240 future reuse events, the learned utility-hazard model still retains 16 harmful memories, while a recency>=4 && frequency<=2 rule tuned on the identical audit labels retains zero harmful memories, quarantines zero beneficial memories, and retains the same 192 beneficial events. The simple recency+frequency policy strictly dominates the learned hazard; retain only a cache/revalidation component pending human merge/drop review.

title.zh: 带适用边界的经验学习

problem.zh: 自然语言经验被过度泛化到表面相似但约束不同的状态。
problem.en: Natural-language lessons are overgeneralized to superficially similar states with different constraints.

hypothesis.zh: 带边界经验应保持正迁移，同时减少跨任务错误调用。
hypothesis.en: Bounded lessons should preserve positive transfer while reducing erroneous cross-task invocation.

mechanism.zh: 每条经验同时保存支持条件、最小反例和弃权区域。
mechanism.en: Store support conditions, minimal counterexamples, and abstention regions with every lesson.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“每条经验同时保存支持条件、最小反例和弃权区域。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Store support conditions, minimal counterexamples, and abstention regions with every lesson., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

novelty_boundary.zh: AgentRefine 改善纠错泛化，但不显式维护每条持久经验的适用域。
novelty_boundary.en: AgentRefine improves refinement generalization but does not explicitly maintain lesson applicability.

strongest_baseline.zh: 按成功写入、语言 Critic、模型置信度、轨迹级消融、随机拒绝。
strongest_baseline.en: Success-only admission, language critics, confidence, trajectory ablation, and random rejection.

title.zh: 重复效应记忆门控

mechanism.zh: 重复效应记忆门控
mechanism.en: Replicated-Effect Memory Gate

decision_reason.zh: B-8 standalone 已停止升级，clean R1 不授权。旧共享 P0 仍是 SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT_METHOD_INCONCLUSIVE + PROVENANCE_INCONCLUSIVE，不得改写成旧方法 FAIL。后续 CPU-only failure diagnosis 解释了“为什么原理看起来成立但 gate 学不出来”：retrieved vs token-matched placebo 的 first-divergence 在 nonzero effect 中显著更早；同物理 RTX3090 regeneration 对 11 个原 nonzero unit 的首分叉位置 11/11 复现、具体首分叉 action pair 10/11 复现，排除了纯随机噪声。但 state-signature localization 很弱（相对最佳 task baseline Brier 仅改善 3.46%，MI permutation p=0.216）；同一 memory se-m-pick_cool_then_place_in_recep-1 在完全相同的 index-0 pre_acquire|navigate>navigate signature 下对 cool/heat/clean target 分别产生 -1/+1/-1。当前最符合的解释是：memory 稳定地改变早期 trajectory branch，但最终 benefit/harm sign 由 downstream context 放大决定；因此 candidate-global replicated-effect 假设过强。该诊断不复活 B-8，也不自动授权替代 idea。 工程上仅保留为 soft audit-priority signal：1-step 约 25% paired-rollout 成本可覆盖 54.5% nonzero effects，但达到 90.9% recall 时 5-step 成本已约 90.1%；因此只能用于审计排序，禁止作为 hard gate 淘汰 confirmatory cases。
decision_reason.en: Standalone B-8 escalation is stopped and a clean R1 is not authorized. The old shared P0 remains SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT_METHOD_INCONCLUSIVE plus PROVENANCE_INCONCLUSIVE and must not be rewritten as an old-method FAIL. A later CPU-only failure diagnosis explains why the principle can look right while the gate remains unlearnable: retrieved versus token-matched placebo diverges significantly earlier on nonzero-effect units. On matched physical RTX3090 regeneration, the first-divergence index reproduces for 11/11 original nonzero units and the exact first-divergent action pair for 10/11, ruling out pure stochastic noise. Yet state-signature localization is weak (only 3.46% Brier improvement over the best task baseline; MI permutation p=0.216). The same memory se-m-pick_cool_then_place_in_recep-1 yields -1/+1/-1 on cool/heat/clean targets under the identical index-0 pre_acquire|navigate>navigate signature. The best current explanation is reproducible early trajectory-branch steering whose downstream context determines benefit versus harm, so the candidate-global replicated-effect assumption was too strong. This diagnosis does not revive B-8 or auto-authorize a replacement idea. Operationally, retain this only as a soft audit-priority signal: a 1-step screen uses about 25% of paired-rollout cost and captures 54.5% of nonzero effects, but reaching 90.9% recall at 5 steps already costs about 90.1%. It may prioritize audit order but must never hard-exclude confirmatory cases.

mechanism.zh: 跨任务效应迁移证书

decision_reason.zh: B-9 standalone 已停止，strict-LOTO 仅保留为 archived secondary diagnostic。旧结果仍是 TRANSPORT_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT，不是方法 FAIL。后续 first-divergence diagnosis 进一步表明，memory effect 的可复现部分主要是“早期 trajectory branch 被稳定改变”，而不是可由 local state/task signature 稳定预测的最终 effect sign：11 个 nonzero unit 的同卡 regeneration 首分叉位置 11/11 复现、action pair 10/11 复现，但完全相同的早期 signature 可在不同 target context 下翻转 sign。因而 B-9 的 task-level effect transport 假设也过强；当前不授权 clean R1、formal-method、第二 backbone 或自动替代 idea。 工程上仅保留为 soft audit-priority signal：1-step 约 25% paired-rollout 成本可覆盖 54.5% nonzero effects，但达到 90.9% recall 时 5-step 成本已约 90.1%；因此只能用于审计排序，禁止作为 hard gate 淘汰 confirmatory cases。
decision_reason.en: Standalone B-9 is stopped; strict LOTO remains only as an archived secondary diagnostic. The old result remains TRANSPORT_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT, not a method FAIL. The later first-divergence diagnosis shows that the reproducible component of memory effect is mainly stable early trajectory-branch steering rather than a final effect sign that is stable under local-state or task signatures: matched-hardware regeneration reproduces the first-divergence index for 11/11 nonzero units and the action pair for 10/11, while an identical early signature can flip sign across downstream target contexts. The task-level effect-transport assumption was therefore also too strong. Clean R1, formal-method work, a second backbone, and automatic replacement-idea creation remain unauthorized. Operationally, retain this only as a soft audit-priority signal: a 1-step screen uses about 25% of paired-rollout cost and captures 54.5% of nonzero effects, but reaching 90.9% recall at 5 steps already costs about 90.1%. It may prioritize audit order but must never hard-exclude confirmatory cases.

title.zh: 约束完备的类型化记忆顺序逻辑

problem.zh: 解决智能体记忆检索中的真实问题：当多个类型化记忆（异常、策略、安全约束、工具模式、观察）被共同检索时，其合法执行顺序取决于高阶、上下文相关的约束，而非简单成对偏好。目标是判断一种持久化的符号约束表征能否在未见过的类型组合上实现系统性泛化，以及编译后的免搜索解码能否在保持精度的同时降低推理成本。
problem.en: Addresses the real problem of ordering co-retrieved typed memories (exceptions, policies, safety constraints, tool schemas, observations) in agents, where legal execution order depends on higher-order, context-dependent constraints rather than simple pairwise preferences. The goal is to determine whether a persistent symbolic constraint representation yields systematic generalization to unseen type compositions, and whether a compiled search-free decoder preserves accuracy at lower inference cost.

hypothesis.zh: 一个可证伪的归纳偏置/效率命题：在相同解码器下，符号子句比同等表达力的类型化 n 元因子具有更好的组合外推；和/或编译在保持求解器精度的同时严格降低推理成本。由于 n 元因子模型可以表达相同的高阶约束，本方案明确不作表征不可能性断言。
hypothesis.en: A falsifiable inductive-bias/efficiency claim: symbolic clauses yield better compositional extrapolation than equally expressive typed n-ary factors under an identical decoder, and/or compilation preserves solver accuracy at strictly lower inference cost. No representational-impossibility claim is made, since the n-ary factor model can express the same higher-order constraints.

mechanism.zh: 保留来源/函数定义的记忆类型与随机置换干预，但将机制重构为预注册的 2×2 表征 × 解码器析因设计。表征因子：(a) 由 MDL 式子句选择诱导的最小符号约束程序（类型化变量、条件反转与交换性子句）；(b) 在相同类型化变量、共现统计与元数覆盖上定义的匹配类型化 n 元因子模型。解码器因子：(i) 测试时精确约束求解器；(ii) 训练后一次性编译并冻结的免搜索解码器（对完整类型化集合的编译策略/查找，无测试时求解）。四个单元共享全部数据、容量与预算。
mechanism.en: Retain provenance/function-defined memory types and randomized permutation interventions, but restructure the mechanism as a preregistered 2×2 representation × decoder factorial. Representation factor: (a) a minimal symbolic constraint program induced by MDL-style clause selection (typed variables, conditional-reversal and commutativity clauses); (b) a matched typed n-ary factor model defined over the same typed variables, co-occurrence statistics, and arity coverage. Decoder factor: (i) an exact test-time constraint solver; (ii) a frozen search-free decoder compiled once after training (compiled policy/lookup over complete typed sets, no test-time solving). All four cells share all data, capacity, and budgets.

method_logic.zh: 训练阶段：对每个训练共检索集合，随机化或系统枚举充分多的置换并独立评估，得到置换-结果数据。符号单元用 MDL 式子句选择保留解释多个独立训练组合的子句；n 元单元在相同类型化变量与元数覆盖上训练因子，参数/子句容量与正则化预算与子句稀疏度匹配。编译阶段（训练后一次性）：将符号子句与 n 元因子分别蒸馏/编译为对完整类型化集合的免搜索解码器并冻结。测试阶段：四个单元全部冻结，在完全保留的新类型组合上比较。
method_logic.en: Training: for each training co-retrieved set, randomize or systematically enumerate sufficiently many permutations and evaluate them independently, yielding permutation-outcome data. The symbolic cells use MDL-style clause selection retaining clauses that explain multiple independent training compositions; the n-ary cells train factors over the same typed variables and arity coverage, with parameter/clause capacity and regularization budget matched to clause sparsity. Compilation (once, after training): distill/compile both symbolic clauses and n-ary factors into search-free decoders over complete typed sets and freeze them. Test: all four cells frozen, compared on fully held-out new type compositions.

novelty_boundary.zh: 与 AGEL-Comp（从经验反馈诱导 Horn 子句用于新组合）及基于 ILP 的组合性符号任务规则学习相近，但本方案的差异在于测试记忆顺序约束的表征 × 解码器分解，并以共享求解器的 n 元因子为最强对照；置换/排序的因子化分布学习提供了非符号的强对照参照。依据所供最近工作上下文，不声称此类分解或对照在文献中不存在。
novelty_boundary.en: Closest to AGEL-Comp (inducing Horn clauses from experiential feedback for novel compositions) and ILP-based compositional symbolic task-rule learning, but differs in testing a representation × decoder factorization for memory-order constraints with a solver-sharing n-ary factor as the strongest control; factorized permutation/ranking distribution learning provides a strong non-symbolic reference point. Per the supplied nearest-work context, no claim is made that such factorizations or controls are absent from the literature.

strongest_baseline.zh: 最强对照为单元 B：与符号子句共享同一精确求解器的类型化 n 元因子模型，匹配参数/子句容量、相同类型、完整集合、置换结果、训练预算与推理候选预算；单元 D（蒸馏为同一免搜索形式的 n 元因子）为免搜索匹配控制。条件成对因子模型与通用集合能量模型保留为次级表达力对照。
strongest_baseline.en: The strongest control is Cell B: a typed n-ary factor model sharing the identical exact solver, with matched parameter/clause capacity, identical types, complete sets, permutation outcomes, training budget, and inference candidate budget; Cell D (n-ary factors distilled into the same search-free form) is the search-free matched control. Conditional Pairwise Factor and Generic Set-Energy Model remain as secondary expressivity controls.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 预注册单一 2×2 析因测试：仅在训练类型组合子集上训练，完全保留需要系统性重组已知约束的新组合（如异常-策略优先规则与安全三元规则的首次共现，或第三类型出现时必须反转的对）。冻结全部四个单元，测量精确成功率、约束违反率、相对穷举 oracle 的遗憾，以及端到端推理成本。符号表征命题仅当符号单元在相同解码器内显著优于匹配 n 元单元时存活；编译命题仅当编译单元在严格更低推理成本下精度不劣于求解器单元时存活。
minimum_falsifier.en: Preregister a single 2×2 factorial test: train only on a subset of type compositions and fully hold out new compositions requiring systematic recombination of known constraints (e.g., first co-occurrence of an Exception-Policy precedence rule with a Safety ternary rule, or a pair whose order must reverse when a third type appears). Freeze all four cells; measure exact-success rate, constraint-violation rate, regret to the exhaustive oracle, and end-to-end inference cost. The symbolic-representation claim survives only if symbolic cells beat matched n-ary cells within the same decoder; the compilation claim survives only if compiled cells match solver-cell accuracy at strictly lower inference cost.

decision_reason.zh: CPU P0 已触发预注册 STOP：32 个全部含有效约束的 held-out 类型组合上，symbolic 与匹配 typed n-ary factor 的 exact accuracy 均为 1.00；将 factor 编译控制限制到与 symbolic 相同 active-edge budget 后，compiled accuracy 仍 1.00 vs 1.00，平均 edge checks 同为 1.125。独立符号表征/编译优势均被 matched simplification 复现，不建议再耗 GPU；等待人工确认 DROP/merge。
decision_reason.en: CPU P0 fired the preregistered STOP. Across 32 held-out type combinations with binding constraints, symbolic and matched typed n-ary factor exact accuracy are both 1.00; after matching the factor compiled control to the same active-edge budget, compiled accuracy remains 1.00 vs 1.00 with identical 1.125 mean edge checks. Both standalone symbolic-representation and compilation advantages are reproduced by the matched simplification, so no GPU expansion is recommended; await human DROP/merge review.

reopen_condition.zh: Stop standalone B-10 and do not spend GPU; retain this P0 as the matched-simplification falsifier and return the drop/merge decision to human review.
reopen_condition.en: Stop standalone B-10 and do not spend GPU; retain this P0 as the matched-simplification falsifier and return the drop/merge decision to human review.

novelty_boundary.zh: The scoped +1.92 ALFWorld residual is already decomposed by the same primary source. Appendix E reports that the full two-timescale system reaches 94.23, while removing only cross-branch retrieval returns accuracy to 92.31, exactly the Single-Level baseline; the authors explicitly state that cross-branch transfer of reusable sub-routines accounts for the whole +1.92 improvement. Thus the observed aggregate residual is not unexplained negative space: source-internal component interventions positively identify the operative cross-branch/meta-update pathway and leave no reported residual requiring a new standalone mechanism.

title.zh: LOPD latent-token and retrieval-count plateaus reduce to capacity saturation and marginal-information redundancy

problem.zh: LOPD latent-token and retrieval-count plateaus reduce to capacity saturation and marginal-information redundancy

hypothesis.zh: LOPD latent-token and retrieval-count plateaus reduce to capacity saturation and marginal-information redundancy
hypothesis.en: LOPD latent-token and retrieval-count plateaus reduce to capacity saturation and marginal-information redundancy

mechanism.zh: LOPD latent-token and retrieval-count plateaus reduce to capacity saturation and marginal-information redundancy
mechanism.en: LOPD latent-token and retrieval-count plateaus reduce to capacity saturation and marginal-information redundancy

novelty_boundary.zh: LOPD's own construction makes both sensitivity curves direct instances of mature capacity and marginal-information effects. The latent composer compresses variable-length task-experience representations into a fixed number of learned latent tokens, so increasing that token count increases representation capacity and a rise followed by saturation is predicted by information-bottleneck/rate-distortion behavior. Separately, retrieval is exact cosine-similarity top-n over a frozen successful-trajectory bank. Increasing n_ret therefore nests lower-ranked experiences into the retrieved set; each additional item is separately encoded/compressed and then contributes additional latent context. A gain from the first few nearest experiences followed by a plateau or fluctuation is predicted by diminishing marginal relevance, correlated/redundant evidence, and context-capacity tradeoffs. The reported curves do not hold total latent budget fixed while independently varying number of experiences versus tokens per experience, so they cannot identify a new decomposition-specific mechanism.

novelty_boundary.zh: DocAtlas already makes unresolved, relevance-conditioned information gaps an explicit mutable control state rather than relying on page-coverage quantity. Its structured Note is n=(found,evidence,plan), where plan states remaining information gaps; subsequent Search consumes accumulated findings and may issue a new sub-question, and Selective Evidence Access explicitly allows reading pages from unresolved gaps recorded in memory. Thus the correct opposite principle discovered from the P06 coverage-count dead end is already a first-class current-source information-seeking mechanism, not a new standalone evidence-debt object.

novelty_boundary.zh: The proposed treatment-semantics predictor is not irreducible under a fair same-information comparison. If the executable memory-to-option/action mapping is observable enough for the proposed predictor to use prospectively, the same mapping must also be supplied to the strongest versioned/nonstationary treatment baseline, which can absorb it into the treatment/state definition, e.g. A_t=(artifact version, executable mapping). If that mapping is not observable before outcome, the proposed predictor cannot prospectively use it either. Withholding the mapping from the baseline while giving it to the candidate creates an information advantage rather than a new causal object.

mechanism.en: SEED on-policy and hindsight-SFT ablation drops reduce to occupancy matching and cold-start capability

novelty_boundary.zh: SEED's own theory and ablation interpretation supply mature explanations for both drops. Appendix A.1 explicitly motivates on-policy hindsight as an occupancy-matched adaptive target: skills extracted from the current policy's own trajectories track its current state-action occupancy and failure modes, whereas a static offline library can be distribution-mismatched as the policy evolves. The 7.4-point static-library drop is therefore directly expressible by ordinary distribution/occupancy shift and stale-supervision principles. Separately, hindsight-skill SFT is the initialization that teaches the actor/analyzer to perform trajectory analysis before the self-evolving RL stage. Removing it changes cold-start representation/competence, so the 5.8-point drop is predicted by initialization and prerequisite-capability effects unless initial analyzer competence and supervised information are matched. Neither one-factor ablation by itself identifies a new causal primitive of self-evolution.

novelty_boundary.zh: On the released FactConsolidation object, the archive fraction is a post-action summary of targeted consolidation, not an independently varied treatment. The benchmark defines the later contradictory fact as the valid memory, while the first-party dreaming pipeline deterministically archives exact duplicates before LLM actions, can merge multiple source memories while archiving the sources, and represents directed conflict resolution with relations such as supersedes. Therefore simultaneously reducing active-memory volume and improving both single- and multi-hop accuracy is predicted by a same-information conflict-aware selective-forgetting/belief-revision account whenever removed memories are duplicate, stale, or contradictory. The paper reports one naturally induced archive fraction per model/hop regime rather than a controlled AMCR sweep, so the observed ~20% operating point does not identify a plateau or cliff in compression ratio.

title.zh: 谱系去相关的自标注准入

problem.zh: multi-agent agreement、pairwise validator 和 uncertainty-aware self-labeling 已经能提高单轮伪标签质量；剩下的问题是跨轮自进化时，同一个早期错误经同源 evaluator/父标签反复派生后被当成多份独立证据。
problem.en: Multi-agent agreement, pairwise validators, and uncertainty-aware labeling can improve one-round pseudo-label quality. The remaining problem is cross-round dependence: one early error can spawn many descendant labels through the same evaluator lineage and be mistakenly counted as independent evidence.

hypothesis.zh: 如果错误主要沿同源谱系传播，谱系去相关后的准入应比当前轮置信度、简单一致性和不看祖先的加权平均更早阻断坏更新，同时保留独立来源支持的好更新。
hypothesis.en: If errors propagate mainly along same-source lineages, lineage-decorrelated admission should block bad updates earlier than current-round confidence, simple consistency, or ancestry-blind weighting while retaining updates supported by independent sources.

mechanism.zh: 为 label-event 建 provenance DAG，记录 generation、producer/evaluator family、parent label 和 update lineage；用少量冻结独立 anchors 估计来源可靠度与 lineage covariance，把共享祖先/同源后代折算成 effective evidence count，再决定 Prompt/Memory/Rubric 更新是否准入。
mechanism.en: Build a provenance DAG for label events with generation, producer/evaluator family, parent labels, and update lineage. Use a small frozen independent anchor set to estimate source reliability and lineage covariance, convert correlated descendants into an effective evidence count, then gate persistent prompt/memory/rubric updates.

method_logic.zh: 0) 先测真实日志中跨轮 label inheritance/同源复用是否存在；1) 记录 4–6 轮 label-event DAG；2) 冻结独立 anchors；3) 估计 producer family reliability 与 shared-ancestry covariance；4) 计算 effective evidence weight；5) 权重只控制轻量持久更新准入；6) 第二 evaluator family 前冻结。
method_logic.en: 0) First verify cross-round label inheritance/source reuse in real logs; 1) record a 4–6 round label-event DAG; 2) freeze independent anchors; 3) estimate producer-family reliability and shared-ancestry covariance; 4) compute effective evidence weights; 5) use them only to gate lightweight persistent updates; 6) freeze before a second evaluator family.

novelty_boundary.zh: SERM 已用 multi-agent agreement 处理 pseudo-label noise，Reward-Free Evolving Agents 用 pairwise validator 替代 scalar reward；因此本方向只保留跨轮 label-event lineage correlation 去重。
novelty_boundary.en: SERM uses multi-agent agreement for pseudo-label noise and Reward-Free Evolving Agents uses pairwise validation instead of scalar rewards; the surviving claim is cross-round label-event lineage-correlation discounting.

strongest_baseline.zh: Same-feature capacity-matched direct history classifier plus confidence, EMA-teacher, and simple source-discount rules.
strongest_baseline.en: Same-feature capacity-matched direct history classifier plus confidence, EMA-teacher, and simple source-discount rules.

minimum_falsifier.zh: Freeze 4-6 rounds and >=200 lineage-linked label decisions; hold out ancestors and later rounds; compare false accepts, clean-label retention, and next-round utility at matched accepted count.
minimum_falsifier.en: Freeze 4-6 rounds and >=200 lineage-linked label decisions; hold out ancestors and later rounds; compare false accepts, clean-label retention, and next-round utility at matched accepted count.

title.zh: 跨版本 Rubric 干预修复

problem.zh: policy 与 internal reward 共进化已经有直接方法；真正难的是 reward 上升时判断究竟是 actor 变好，还是 evaluator/rubric 自己漂向 actor 的捷径。
problem.en: Direct methods already co-evolve policy and internal reward. The unresolved problem is attribution: when reward rises, did the actor improve or did the evaluator/rubric drift toward the actor's shortcut?

hypothesis.zh: 跨版本门控应降低外部 Judge 和人工小样本上的 reward hacking。
hypothesis.en: Cross-version gating should reduce reward hacking under external judges and small human audits.

mechanism.zh: 保存 actor/evaluator 版本矩阵。对固定 anchor trajectories 做跨版本交叉评分，先用 actor-fixed/evaluator-changed 的 delta 定位 evaluator drift；再对可疑 rubric 维度做 neutral/counterfactual rubric intervention，只允许小型 rubric/calibrator patch，且该 evidence batch 上 actor 保持冻结。
mechanism.en: Maintain an actor/evaluator version matrix. Cross-score fixed anchor trajectories across versions and localize evaluator drift using actor-fixed/evaluator-changed deltas; then apply neutral/counterfactual rubric interventions to suspicious rubric dimensions, allowing only small rubric/calibrator patches while the actor remains frozen on that evidence batch.

method_logic.zh: 1) 每轮保留 actor/evaluator snapshot；2) 冻结独立 anchors；3) 构造 cross-version score matrix；4) 分解 actor-change 与 evaluator-change；5) 对 evaluator-side drift 做 rubric neutralization/counterfactual intervention；6) 仅训练稀疏 calibrator/rubric patch；7) 下一轮 actor 更新使用不同 evidence。
method_logic.en: 1) Retain actor/evaluator snapshots each round; 2) freeze independent anchors; 3) build a cross-version score matrix; 4) separate actor-change from evaluator-change; 5) perform rubric neutralization/counterfactual intervention on evaluator-side drift; 6) train only a sparse calibrator/rubric patch; 7) the next actor update uses different evidence.

novelty_boundary.zh: Self-Guide 已直接共进化 policy/internal reward，REFORM 也让 reward model 自发现 failure 并修复。因此 novelty 不能是 reward self-improvement，而是 cross-version actor-fixed attribution + rubric intervention 后的 evaluator-only sparse repair。
novelty_boundary.en: Self-Guide directly co-evolves policy/internal reward and REFORM lets reward models discover and repair their own failures. Novelty is not reward self-improvement, but actor-fixed cross-version attribution plus rubric intervention followed by evaluator-only sparse repair.

strongest_baseline.zh: frozen reward / judge ensemble / evaluator disagreement + 简单 rubric repair。
strongest_baseline.en: Frozen reward/judge ensemble/evaluator disagreement plus simpler rubric repair.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 至少 3×3 actor/evaluator cross-score；先归因，再只对 evaluator-side drift 做稀疏因果 repair，独立 anchors 判真。
minimum_falsifier.en: At least a 3×3 actor/evaluator cross-score; attribute first, then sparsely repair only evaluator-side drift, with independent anchors defining truth.

decision_reason.zh: C-2 CPU P0 已触发 matched-simplification STOP：3×3 actor/evaluator cross-score 使用 frozen external anchors。cross-version attribution 与简单 per-evaluator anchor residual 都 3/3 正确定位 evaluator drift；causal neutralization 估出的 evaluator bias / shortcut-weight 与同一 anchor outputs 上的简单 intercept+shortcut calibration 参数逐项完全相同，repair MAE/max-error 也完全相同。proposed 还额外需要 54 次 causal intervention calls，而简单校准为 0。cross-version matrix 只保留诊断价值，独立 attribution + causal sparse repair 机制不再推进，等待人工确认 merge/drop。
decision_reason.en: C-2 CPU P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP on a 3x3 actor/evaluator cross-score matrix with frozen external anchors. Cross-version attribution and a simple per-evaluator anchor-residual baseline both identify evaluator drift correctly in 3/3 evaluators. The evaluator bias/shortcut parameters estimated by causal neutralization are exactly identical to simple intercept+shortcut calibration on the same anchor outputs, with identical repair MAE/max error. The proposed mechanism additionally requires 54 causal intervention calls versus 0 for simple calibration. Keep the cross-version matrix only as a diagnostic; the standalone attribution + causal sparse-repair mechanism should not progress pending human merge/drop review.

reopen_condition.zh: Keep cross-version matrices only as diagnostics; merge evaluator repair into simple frozen-anchor calibration and do not spend GPU on standalone C-2.
reopen_condition.en: Keep cross-version matrices only as diagnostics; merge evaluator repair into simple frozen-anchor calibration and do not spend GPU on standalone C-2.

title.zh: 奖励不变性审计

problem.zh: Reward 对语义无关格式、背景或表述敏感时，Agent 会优化捷径。
problem.en: Agents exploit shortcuts when rewards respond to semantically irrelevant format, background, or phrasing.

hypothesis.zh: 可靠 Reward 应对无关变化稳定、对语义改变敏感，并预测真实选择错误。
hypothesis.en: Reliable rewards should be invariant to irrelevant changes, sensitive to semantic changes, and predictive of real selection errors.

mechanism.zh: 用语义保持、语义改变正对照和捷径探针三类 matched interventions 测选择性不变性。
mechanism.en: Use matched semantics-preserving, semantics-changing positive controls, and shortcut probes to measure selective invariance.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“用语义保持、语义改变正对照和捷径探针三类 matched interventions 测选择性不变性。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Use matched semantics-preserving, semantics-changing positive controls, and shortcut probes to measure selective invariance., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

novelty_boundary.zh: Constrained RLHF 研究过优化；本方法提供跨任务域、无需训练的干预诊断。
novelty_boundary.en: Constrained RLHF studies overoptimization; this provides cross-domain intervention diagnostics without training.

strongest_baseline.zh: 冻结 Reward、同模型自评、独立 Reward、自进化 Reward、人工小样本校准、多 Judge。
strongest_baseline.en: Frozen rewards, same-model self-evaluation, independent rewards, self-evolved rewards, small human calibration, and judge ensembles.

title.zh: 自纠正坍塌检测

problem.zh: 模型可能学会频繁改答案、偏好格式或迎合 Reward，而不是真正纠错。
problem.en: A model may learn to change answers, prefer a format, or please a reward without genuinely correcting errors.

hypothesis.zh: 真实纠正应同时提高修复并保持正确答案和无关稳定性。
hypothesis.en: Real correction should improve repair while preserving correct answers and irrelevant invariance.

mechanism.zh: 用正确答案保持、错误答案修复和反事实敏感性三轴定义纠正坍塌。
mechanism.en: Define correction collapse using correct-answer preservation, error repair, and counterfactual sensitivity.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“用正确答案保持、错误答案修复和反事实敏感性三轴定义纠正坍塌。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Define correction collapse using correct-answer preservation, error repair, and counterfactual sensitivity., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

novelty_boundary.en: SCoRe analyzes training collapse; this provides a cross-model, training-free audit.

title.zh: 干预验证自纠正

problem.zh: Critique 可能只是事后合理化，修复其声称的变量并不会按预期改变答案。
problem.en: A critique may be post-hoc rationalization: fixing the claimed variable may not change the answer as predicted.

hypothesis.zh: 通过干预验证的纠正应具有更高修复率和迁移性。
hypothesis.en: Intervention-validated corrections should repair more reliably and transfer better.

mechanism.en: Before accepting a correction, execute a minimal step, observation, or tool intervention and test directional causal consistency.

novelty_boundary.zh: The frozen PA-05 statistic is exactly a source-to-target model-selection comparison under deliberate distribution shift. Its local selector observes the T1-T3 within-environment performance difference between two representations, while its oracle is defined by the T4 context-shift, T5 adversarial, and T6 composition performance difference. Ranking reversal and oracle-versus-local regret are therefore direct predictions of ordinary validation/deployment mismatch, domain shift, and conditional treatment-effect heterogeneity whenever source-domain performance is not invariant for the target roles. Matching the latent family and comparing the same two arms removes family difficulty and global-arm confounding, but it does not change this statistical object: the remaining representation-by-role interaction is precisely the effect modification a generic distribution-shift or domain-generalization model is allowed to express. Naming the two arms raw trajectory reuse and distilled skill memory does not create a distinct selection principle.

novelty_boundary.zh: The proposed CONTRADICTION requires the two reported signs to estimate the same treatment under a shared operationalization, but the primary papers intervene on different causal surfaces. MetaSkill-Evolve's Static Skill loads a fixed skill into a frozen Gemma-4 31B agent and compares held-out task accuracy against the same no-skill executor; on ALFWorld that inference-time skill changes 92.31% to 90.38% (-1.93 points). SkillCoach's R0 result is not an inference-time static-context effect: R0 is a task-level process rubric used to score and filter verifier-passing trajectories, and the reported 8->16 and 14->28 gains are measured after supervised fine-tuning on the filtered demonstrations. That intervention changes the training set and then model parameters. Opposite signs across an inference-time frozen-agent skill treatment and a rubric-filtered SFT treatment do not constitute incompatible outcomes under one treatment contract, so the claimed cross-regime sign contradiction is not identified before either headroom or applicability theory is tested.

title.zh: 1-Minimal 边界反例课程

problem.zh: counterexample-guided learning、formal counterexample generation 和 CEDAR 已经证明 verifier 反例能驱动学习；剩下的问题只是在完全相同 verifier/训练预算下，1-minimality 本身是否让课程更高信息、更少 shortcut。
problem.en: Counterexample-guided learning, formal counterexample generation, and CEDAR already show verifier counterexamples can drive learning. The remaining question is whether 1-minimality itself creates a more informative, less shortcut-prone curriculum under identical verifier/training budget.

hypothesis.zh: 在相同生成、验证和训练 token 下，1-minimal 反例应比失败重放、随机扰动和 verifier 过滤但不做最小化的任务产生更强的未见边界泛化。
hypothesis.en: At matched generation, verification, and training tokens, verified 1-minimal counterexamples should improve unseen boundary generalization more than failure replay, random perturbations, or verifier-filtered but non-minimized tasks.

mechanism.zh: P0 中强模型 proposer 完全冻结，不参与任何迭代更新；它只在固定调用预算内提出候选边界任务，程序/环境 verifier 独立判真。对验证反例逐约束 delta-debug，直到任何进一步删除都会使任务失效或不再反驳当前规则；只把 1-minimal 反例送入小模型的固定 token Prompt/LoRA/skill 更新。这样把‘反例质量’与‘教师自己越来越强’严格分开。
mechanism.en: In P0 the stronger proposer is fully frozen and never iteratively updated. It only proposes candidate boundary tasks under a fixed call budget, while a program/environment verifier independently supplies truth. Delta-debug each verified counterexample until any further constraint removal makes it invalid or no longer refutes the current rule; only 1-minimal counterexamples enter the smaller model's fixed-token prompt/LoRA/skill update. This separates counterexample quality from a teacher that itself improves over time.

method_logic.zh: 1) 从当前小模型轨迹抽取可执行规则/任务模板；2) 冻结强模型 proposer，整个 P0 不更新其参数、Prompt 或 memory，只按固定预算提候选；3) 独立 verifier 判合法和是否反例；4) delta-debug 到 1-minimal；5) 只更新被研究的小模型/skill，最终训练样本/token 与 non-minimal baseline 严格匹配；6) 更新后在独立模板/seed 边界集测试。
method_logic.en: 1) Extract an executable rule/task template from the current smaller-model trajectories; 2) freeze the stronger proposer for the entire P0—no parameter, prompt, or memory updates—and use only a fixed proposal budget; 3) an independent verifier checks legality and counterexample status; 4) delta-debug to 1-minimality; 5) update only the studied smaller model/skill while strictly matching final training samples/tokens to the non-minimal baseline; 6) test on independent templates/seeds.

novelty_boundary.zh: Counterexample Guided Learning in the Large、CEDAR、Learning to Disprove 已覆盖 verifier counterexample learning；因此唯一剩余主张是 1-minimality 作为 curriculum selection variable 的独立价值。
novelty_boundary.en: Counterexample Guided Learning in the Large, CEDAR, and Learning to Disprove already cover verifier counterexample learning. The only surviving claim is the independent value of 1-minimality as a curriculum-selection variable.

strongest_baseline.zh: 同一 verifier-filtered counterexamples，不做 minimization，最终 training token 严格匹配。
strongest_baseline.en: The same verifier-filtered counterexamples without minimization, with final training tokens strictly matched.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 1-minimal curriculum 做一次冻结更新，与 token-matched non-minimal curriculum 比 unseen boundary generalization。
minimum_falsifier.en: Perform one frozen update with the 1-minimal curriculum and compare unseen-boundary generalization against the token-matched non-minimal curriculum.

decision_reason.zh: D-1 CPU P0 已触发 matched-simplification STOP：20 条规则各有 4 个 verifier-confirmed non-minimal counterexamples，1-minimal arm 对 80 个样本逐约束 minimization，额外花 320 次 verifier calls；更简单的 matched baseline 不做 per-example delta-debug，只对同一规则的多条已验证反例取 constraint intersection。两臂最终编译出的 20 个更新逐项完全相同，训练 token 都严格为 320，独立 hidden boundary 60/60 vs 60/60。intersection baseline 无额外 minimization calls，因此 1-minimality 本身没有独立 curriculum 增益，建议并回 generic counterexample learning，等待人工确认 merge/drop。
decision_reason.en: D-1 CPU P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP. For 20 rules with four verifier-confirmed non-minimal counterexamples each, the 1-minimal arm performs per-example constraint minimization and spends 320 additional verifier calls. A simpler matched baseline performs no per-example delta debugging and instead intersects the multiple verified counterexamples for each rule. The two arms compile exactly identical updates for all 20 rules, use the same 320-token final training budget, and both score 60/60 on the independent hidden boundary set. The intersection baseline needs no extra minimization calls, so 1-minimality itself provides no standalone curriculum gain and should merge into generic counterexample learning pending human merge/drop review.
