title.zh: 失败前沿课程

problem.zh: 失败生成课程容易重复旧失败或制造超出当前学习能力的无效难题。
problem.en: Failure-generated curricula duplicate old failures or create tasks beyond the useful learning frontier.

hypothesis.zh: 前沿任务应以更少样本获得更高圈外提升。
hypothesis.en: Frontier tasks should yield more out-of-loop gain per sample.

mechanism.zh: 只保留位于当前成功—失败边界附近且能区分相邻 checkpoint 的任务。
mechanism.en: Keep only tasks near the success-failure boundary that discriminate adjacent checkpoints.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“只保留位于当前成功—失败边界附近且能区分相邻 checkpoint 的任务。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Keep only tasks near the success-failure boundary that discriminate adjacent checkpoints., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

novelty_boundary.zh: WebRL 从失败生成任务；本方法增加 checkpoint 判别性和圈外验证。
novelty_boundary.en: WebRL generates tasks from failures; this adds checkpoint discriminativeness and out-of-loop validation.

strongest_baseline.zh: Uniform fuzzing, failure-frequency, uncertainty sampling, D-1 verifier-filtered generation, and a same-feature direct mutation-yield predictor.
strongest_baseline.en: Uniform fuzzing, failure-frequency, uncertainty sampling, D-1 verifier-filtered generation, and a same-feature direct mutation-yield predictor.

minimum_falsifier.zh: Use >=3 sequential agent versions and 30 typed mutation operators with fixed train tokens; hold out the final version/task family and measure boundary coverage and next-version utility.
minimum_falsifier.en: Use >=3 sequential agent versions and 30 typed mutation operators with fixed train tokens; hold out the final version/task family and measure boundary coverage and next-version utility.

decision_reason.en: The current automatic-curriculum setting is not mature enough.

reopen_condition.en: Merge into direct mutation-yield prediction.

title.zh: 课程漂移控制器

problem.zh: 在线课程改变策略分布，旧 Reward 和任务生成器随迭代失配。
problem.en: Online curricula shift policy distributions, making rewards and task generators stale.

hypothesis.zh: 漂移信号应在锚点退化前预测回退。
hypothesis.en: Drift signals should predict regression before anchor degradation.

mechanism.zh: 用固定锚点和行为分布距离监测漂移，并触发 replay、减小更新或停止。
mechanism.en: Monitor drift with frozen anchors and behavioral distance, triggering replay, smaller updates, or stopping.

method_logic.zh: 从失败或更新候选中抽取状态，应用“用固定锚点和行为分布距离监测漂移，并触发 replay、减小更新或停止。”，在隔离 calibration 与 regression 集上比较后 commit、局部修复或 rollback。
method_logic.en: Extract states from failures or candidate updates, apply: Monitor drift with frozen anchors and behavioral distance, triggering replay, smaller updates, or stopping., compare on isolated calibration and regression sets, then commit, locally repair, or roll back.

novelty_boundary.zh: WebRL 控制训练漂移，但缺少跨方法统一、可审计的课程漂移指标。
novelty_boundary.en: WebRL controls training drift but lacks a unified, auditable curriculum-drift metric.

strongest_baseline.zh: 静态数据、随机重采样、失败重放、难度课程、WebRL 式生成、等量人工任务。
strongest_baseline.en: Static data, random resampling, failure replay, difficulty curricula, WebRL-style generation, and equal-size human tasks.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 在 WebArena-Lite、ALFWorld 上，以 1 GPU、22 GPU 小时完成两个开放模型和至少两个任务域的 P0/P1/P2 验证。
minimum_falsifier.en: Run P0/P1/P2 on WebArena-Lite, ALFWorld with two open models and at least two domains within 1 GPUs and 22 GPU-hours.

decision_reason.en: Shares D-2's immature automatic-curriculum premise and is not an active idea this cycle.

title.zh: 条件编辑排序工作流策略

problem.zh: WorkflowPerturb、Agentic Predictor、FLORA 已覆盖 workflow 扰动/性能预测，CE-Graph 也已根据 failure distribution 做 targeted graph edits；因此不能再做 certificate。剩下的问题是：能否从历史 before/after 编辑试验中学出一个冻结后可跨 workflow 直接选 edit 的持久 update policy。
problem.en: WorkflowPerturb, Agentic Predictor, and FLORA cover workflow perturbation/performance prediction, while CE-Graph already applies failure-driven targeted graph edits. A certificate is no longer enough. The remaining question is whether paired before/after edit interventions can train a persistent update policy that directly chooses edits on unseen workflows after freezing.

hypothesis.zh: 通过证书的工作流应更好迁移到未见工具和任务图。
hypothesis.en: Certified workflows should transfer better to unseen tools and task graphs.

mechanism.zh: 冻结 typed edit library 与 workflow 局部上下文表示。Source workflow 只做单编辑 paired before/after 干预得到 ΔU；学习同一 workflow 内 edit_i 与 edit_j 的 pairwise 排序或 normalized regret，而不是‘edit 是否有正收益’二分类。冻结后在未见 workflow 上禁止候选试跑，只允许直接选择并持久提交一个 edit。
mechanism.en: Freeze a typed edit library and local workflow-context representation. Source workflows provide paired single-edit before/after interventions yielding ΔU. Learn pairwise edit ranking or normalized regret within each workflow rather than binary positive-effect classification. Freeze before unseen workflows, forbid candidate trials, and allow exactly one edit selection and persistent commit.

method_logic.zh: 1) 冻结 typed edit library；2) source workflows 上做 matched before/after 单编辑干预；3) 用真实 execution ΔU 监督 edit-effect policy；4) 控制 edit type/frequency 和 execution budget；5) 冻结 policy；6) hidden workflow 上禁止 candidate trials，只允许一次 edit 选择+commit；7) 最终在未见 API/graph motif 测 persistent benefit。
method_logic.en: 1) Freeze a typed edit library; 2) run matched before/after single-edit interventions on source workflows; 3) supervise the edit-effect policy with true execution ΔU; 4) control edit type/frequency and execution budget; 5) freeze the policy; 6) forbid candidate trials on hidden workflows and allow one edit choice+commit; 7) measure persistent benefit on unseen APIs/graph motifs.

novelty_boundary.zh: WorkflowPerturb 已覆盖 controlled perturbation，Agentic Predictor/FLORA 已覆盖 performance prediction，CE-Graph 已覆盖 failure-driven propose-and-verify。只保留 paired edit interventions → frozen zero-search editor 这一边界。
novelty_boundary.en: WorkflowPerturb covers controlled perturbation, Agentic Predictor/FLORA cover performance prediction, and CE-Graph covers failure-driven propose-and-verify. The surviving boundary is paired edit interventions yielding a frozen zero-search editor.

strongest_baseline.zh: calibrated absolute predictor + threshold；nearest-neighbor edit-effect reuse。
strongest_baseline.en: Calibrated absolute predictor plus threshold; nearest-neighbor edit-effect reuse.

minimum_falsifier.zh: source workflows 学真实 ΔU(edit|workflow,failure)，hidden workflow 禁试跑并只提交一个 edit，以 programmatic post-commit truth 评估。
minimum_falsifier.en: Learn true DeltaU(edit|workflow,failure) on source workflows; on hidden workflows forbid trials and commit exactly one edit, judged by programmatic post-commit truth.

decision_reason.zh: E-1 当前 frozen paired edit-effect source table 触发 ranking-substrate STOP：16 个 workflows×5 edits 中仅 4/16 有任何正 edit，只有 3 个 workflow 的 edit delta 可唯一排序，effective fraction=25%。因此 STOP_CURRENT_EDIT_TABLE_RANKING_DEGENERATE；hidden workflows 未打开，Paired Edit-Effect Workflow Update Policy 方法本体未判。
decision_reason.en: The current E-1 frozen paired edit-effect source table fires a ranking-substrate STOP: among 16 workflows x 5 edits, only 4/16 have any positive edit and only 3 workflows have uniquely rankable edit deltas, for an effective fraction of 25%. Therefore STOP_CURRENT_EDIT_TABLE_RANKING_DEGENERATE fires; hidden workflows were never opened and the Paired Edit-Effect Workflow Update Policy itself is not adjudicated.

reopen_condition.zh: Do not open hidden workflows or train the E-1 ranker on this table. Reopen only after a newly frozen paired intervention table has genuine non-tied edit effects at the preregistered source gate; otherwise send E-1 to human pivot/drop review.
reopen_condition.en: Do not open hidden workflows or train the E-1 ranker on this table. Reopen only after a newly frozen paired intervention table has genuine non-tied edit effects at the preregistered source gate; otherwise send E-1 to human pivot/drop review.

primary_next_action.action_zh: 保持 HOLD；只有满足已记录的重开条件后，才重新进入科学评审。

title.zh: 故障模式因果重写语法

problem.zh: CE-Graph 已经会从 failure distribution 定位 recurring mode 并 propose-and-verify graph edit，因此单纯 branch credit 不足。剩余问题是：能否用少量 group intervention 找到真正致因子图，并把跨 workflow 重复的 cause→rewrite 编译成冻结 grammar，后续不再搜索。
problem.en: CE-Graph already identifies recurring failure modes and propose-and-verifies graph edits, so branch credit alone is insufficient. The remaining problem is whether sparse group interventions can identify causal subgraphs and compile recurring cause→rewrite mappings into a frozen grammar reusable without search.

hypothesis.zh: 结构信用应减少达到同等性能所需的搜索评估，并跨任务复用。
hypothesis.en: Structural credit should reduce search evaluations required for the same performance and transfer across tasks.

mechanism.zh: 先用单轨迹执行图/surrogate 给节点边分组，再对少量 group 做 disable/replace intervention，自适应下钻到最小 causal subgraph。把多次验证得到的 (failure motif, local graph context)→typed rewrite 编译成 grammar；hidden workflow 只允许 grammar 直接重写一次。
mechanism.en: Use single-trajectory execution graphs/surrogates to group nodes/edges, then apply disable/replace interventions to a few groups and adaptively descend to a minimal causal subgraph. Compile repeatedly validated (failure motif, local graph context)→typed rewrite rules into a grammar; hidden workflows allow only one direct grammar rewrite.

method_logic.zh: 1) 冻结 failure traces/workflow graphs；2) surrogate 只做廉价 group ranking；3) 对 top groups 做 matched intervention 并自适应下钻；4) verifier/任务 truth 确认 minimal causal subgraph；5) 跨 workflow 聚合同类 motif；6) 编译 typed rewrite grammar；7) hidden workflow 零搜索应用一次。
method_logic.en: 1) Freeze failure traces/workflow graphs; 2) use a surrogate only for cheap group ranking; 3) run matched interventions on top groups and adaptively descend; 4) verify a minimal causal subgraph with task truth; 5) aggregate recurring motifs across workflows; 6) compile a typed rewrite grammar; 7) apply once with zero search on hidden workflows.

novelty_boundary.zh: CE-Graph 已把 recurring failure distribution→targeted graph edit 做成方法；因此不能主张 failure-guided refinement。只保留 intervention-confirmed minimal causal subgraph → reusable rewrite grammar。
novelty_boundary.en: CE-Graph already maps recurring failure distributions to targeted graph edits, so failure-guided refinement is not novel. The surviving claim is intervention-confirmed minimal causal subgraph → reusable rewrite grammar.

strongest_baseline.zh: E-1 one-shot paired edit-effect policy + CE-Graph-style editor，matched calls。
strongest_baseline.en: E-1 one-shot paired edit-effect policy plus a CE-Graph-style editor at matched calls.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 单图+surrogate 排 structural credit，少量 group interventions 验关键 subgraphs；跨 identity/API-disjoint workflows 重复 motif 后编译 frozen rewrite，hidden zero-search apply。
minimum_falsifier.en: Rank structural credit from a single graph+surrogate, verify key subgraphs with few group interventions, require motifs to recur across identity/API-disjoint workflows, compile frozen rewrites, and apply zero-search on hidden workflows.

decision_reason.zh: E-2 CPU P0 已触发 matched-simplification STOP：16 个 source workflows 覆盖 4 类 failure motif，每类 4 次；causal grammar 与 E-1-style typed paired edit-effect baseline 都严格使用 32 个 source calls。冻结后在 8 个 API/identity-disjoint hidden workflows 上，两者均 8/8 success、0 harmful rewrite、0 hidden search，且 8/8 选择完全相同的 rewrite。结构 credit/group intervention 没有产生超出直接 paired edit-effect reuse 的独立价值，建议并回 E-1/CE-Graph，等待人工确认 merge/drop。
decision_reason.en: E-2 CPU P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP. Sixteen source workflows cover four failure motifs with four repetitions each; the causal grammar and an E-1-style typed paired edit-effect baseline both use exactly 32 source calls. After freezing, both achieve 8/8 success, zero harmful rewrites, zero hidden search, and identical rewrites on all eight API/identity-disjoint hidden workflows. Structural credit/group intervention adds no value beyond direct paired edit-effect reuse, so E-2 should merge back into E-1/CE-Graph pending human merge/drop review.

reopen_condition.zh: Merge E-2 motif context into E-1/CE-Graph-style editing; do not spend GPU on a standalone causal-rewrite paper.
reopen_condition.en: Merge E-2 motif context into E-1/CE-Graph-style editing; do not spend GPU on a standalone causal-rewrite paper.

title.zh: 限探针 API 转移算子

problem.zh: 在 API 迁移中，名称与模式相似的调用仍可能在前置条件、状态副作用与错误恢复语义上存在差异，导致主流程可运行而恢复分支静默失效。本想法旨在以固定的 N 次目标 API 探针预算，将源工作流可靠迁移到未见过的新 API，并重点保护恢复分支语义。
problem.en: Across API migrations, calls with similar names and schemas can still differ in preconditions, state effects, and error-recovery semantics, so the main workflow may execute while recovery branches silently break. This idea aims to migrate a source workflow to an unseen target API under a fixed budget of N target probes, with emphasis on preserving recovery-branch semantics.

hypothesis.zh: 在相同类型化表示与相同探针/调用/修复预算下，跨源学习的 P/E/X 参数化相比由相同文档、模式与探针非学习实例化的同构表示，能在未见过目标 API 上严格更好地保持隐藏恢复分支语义，且该增益跨 API 族复现。该主张仅在非学习实例化规则通过预注册的规则质量验证（即在源 API 上产生的 P/E/X 字段达到预注册合理性阈值）后成立。这是一个可证伪的迁移/效率主张，而非表示不可能性主张——基线能够表达相同的算子。
hypothesis.en: Under the identical typed representation and identical probe/call/repair budgets, cross-source learned parameterization of P/E/X yields strictly better hidden recovery-branch semantic preservation on unseen target APIs than the identically-structured representation instantiated non-learnedly from the same documentation, schemas, and probes, and the gain replicates across API families. This claim holds only after the non-learned instantiation rules pass preregistered rule-quality validation (i.e., the P/E/X fields produced on source APIs meet preregistered reasonableness thresholds). This is a falsifiable transfer/efficiency claim, not a representational-impossibility claim—the baseline can express the same operators.

mechanism.zh: 将每个 API 操作表示为类型化转移算子 T=(P,E,X)：P 为可判定的调用前状态谓词，E 为成功后状态增量，X 将错误类别映射到可恢复状态与可采纳的恢复动作。关键修复：同一 P/E/X 类型化表示被用于两个臂——(a) 跨源学习参数化：在多个源 API 族上通过受控状态对与故障注入监督训练共享参数化；(b) 非学习实例化：通过确定性规则从目标 API 文档、模式与同样的 N 次探针直接填充 P/E/X 字段。两臂使用完全相同的表示结构、编译流水线与预算；唯一差异是参数来自跨源学习还是固定规则实例化。N 次探针后，算子与编译后的工作流均被冻结，评估期间无执行-修复循环。
mechanism.en: Represent every API operation as a typed transition operator T=(P,E,X): P is a decidable pre-call state predicate, E is the post-success state delta, and X maps error classes to recoverable states and admissible recovery actions. Key repair: the identical P/E/X typed representation is used in two arms—(a) cross-source learned parameterization, where a shared parameterization is trained on controlled state pairs and fault injections across multiple source API families; and (b) non-learned instantiation, where the same P/E/X fields are filled by deterministic rules from target documentation, schemas, and the same N probes. Both arms share the exact same representational structure, compilation pipeline, and budget; the only difference is whether parameters come from cross-source learning or fixed-rule instantiation. After the N probes, both the operator and the compiled workflow are frozen with no execution-repair loop during evaluation.

method_logic.zh: 两种方法均将源工作流编译为同一类型化 P/E/X 表示上的算子图，并发射目标调用与恢复边。学习臂通过跨源监督训练填充算子参数；基线臂通过固定解析/推理规则从文档、模式与探针结果填充相同字段。表示、探针预算、编译流水线与冻结协议保持恒定。R3.2 新增：在决定性试点之前，执行预注册的规则质量验证——将固定非学习规则应用于源 API（其真实状态转移与恢复语义从训练数据已知），并检查所产生的 P/E/X 字段是否达到预注册的合理性阈值。若规则未通过验证，则在预注册协议下改进规则并重新验证，或明确报告非学习实例化为弱基线并相应收缩主张。评估在隐藏故障注入下进行，比较两臂在未揭示恢复分支上的语义保持与端到端成功率。
method_logic.en: Both methods compile the source workflow into an operator graph over the same typed P/E/X representation and emit target calls plus recovery edges. The learned arm fills operator parameters via cross-source supervised training; the baseline arm fills the same fields via fixed parsing/inference rules from documentation, schemas, and probe outcomes. Representation, probe budget, compilation pipeline, and freezing protocol are held constant. R3.2 adds: before the decisive pilot, execute a preregistered rule-quality validation—apply the fixed non-learned rules to source APIs (whose ground-truth state transitions and recovery semantics are known from training data) and check whether the resulting P/E/X fields meet preregistered reasonableness thresholds. If the rules fail validation, improve them under a preregistered protocol and re-validate, or explicitly report the non-learned instantiation as a weak baseline and narrow the claim accordingly. Evaluation runs under hidden fault injections, comparing the two arms on semantic preservation of unrevealed recovery branches and end-to-end success.

novelty_boundary.zh: 与 Agent-First Tool API 的区别：该工作使恢复语义在面向智能体的语义接口中显式化，但并不从有界目标探针中学习迁移算子；本想法的核心是比较跨源学习参数化与同构非学习实例化。与 ProEvolve 的区别：该工作以类型化关系图表示版本关联的工具/模式演化，但它是基准生成框架而非限探针迁移学习器。不主张这些文献不存在或未覆盖相关问题，仅主张本想法的识别性比较（学习 vs 同构非学习、限探针、隐藏恢复分支评估）未被其直接覆盖。
novelty_boundary.en: Difference from Agent-First Tool API: that work makes recovery semantics explicit in an agent-oriented semantic interface but does not learn migration operators from bounded target probes; this idea's core is comparing cross-source learned parameterization against an identically-structured non-learned instantiation. Difference from ProEvolve: that work represents version-linked tool/schema evolution with typed relational graphs but is a benchmark-generation framework rather than a bounded-probe migration learner. We do not claim this literature does not exist or fails to cover related problems, only that the identifying comparison here (learned vs. identically-structured non-learned, bounded probes, hidden recovery-branch evaluation) is not directly covered by it.

strongest_baseline.zh: 最强简化基线：由相同文档、模式与 N 次探针非学习实例化的同构 P/E/X 类型化转移算子，容量匹配，编译流水线与端到端预算相同，N 次探针后同样冻结。该基线的固定规则必须通过预注册的规则质量验证：在源 API（其真实状态转移与恢复语义已知）上运行，确认所产生的 P/E/X 字段达到预注册的合理性阈值。若规则未通过验证，则在预注册协议下改进并重新验证，或明确报告为弱基线。附加对照：使用相同文档、模式、N 探针、token 与调用的直接 LLM 工作流改写，加相同的有界执行-修复预算；以及经由固定手工设计通用 IR 的编译。
strongest_baseline.en: Strongest simplification: the identically-structured P/E/X typed transition operator instantiated non-learnedly from the same documentation, schemas, and N probes, with matched capacity, the same compilation pipeline and end-to-end budget, and likewise frozen after N probes. The fixed rules of this baseline must pass preregistered rule-quality validation: run on source APIs (whose ground-truth state transitions and recovery semantics are known) and confirm the resulting P/E/X fields meet preregistered reasonableness thresholds. If the rules fail validation, improve them under a preregistered protocol and re-validate, or explicitly report as a weak baseline. Additional controls: direct LLM workflow rewriting with the same documentation, schemas, N probes, tokens, and calls plus the same bounded execution-repair budget; and compilation through a fixed hand-designed general IR.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 预注册 2×2 交叉析因实验：{跨源学习 P/E/X 参数化, 非学习模式实例化 P/E/X} × {未见过 API 族 A, 未见过 API 族 B}。迁移包含正常路径与多条恢复分支的小型工作流。每个方法获得完全相同的文档、模式、N 次目标探针、token、调用与修复预算；N 次探针后全部冻结。在交叉析因实验之前，执行预注册的规则质量验证：将固定非学习规则应用于源 API（其真实状态转移与恢复语义已知），确认所产生的 P/E/X 字段在预注册指标上达到合理性阈值。若规则未通过验证，则在预注册协议下改进规则并重新验证，或明确报告非学习实例化为弱基线并相应收缩主张。独立隐藏线束在隐藏故障注入下评估恢复分支语义保持与端到端成功率。仅当学习臂在相同预算下显著提升隐藏恢复分支语义保持，且该增益在第二个 API 族上复现时，机制主张才存活。
minimum_falsifier.en: A single preregistered 2×2 crossed factorial: {cross-source learned P/E/X parameterization, non-learned schema-instantiated P/E/X} × {unseen API family A, unseen API family B}. Migrate small workflows containing normal paths and multiple recovery branches. Every method receives identical documentation, schemas, N target probes, tokens, calls, and repair budget; everything is frozen after N probes. Before the crossed factorial, execute preregistered rule-quality validation: apply the fixed non-learned rules to source APIs (whose ground-truth state transitions and recovery semantics are known) and confirm the resulting P/E/X fields meet preregistered reasonableness thresholds on preregistered metrics. If the rules fail validation, improve them under a preregistered protocol and re-validate, or explicitly report the non-learned instantiation as a weak baseline and narrow the claim accordingly. The independent hidden harness evaluates recovery-branch semantic preservation and end-to-end success under hidden fault injections. The mechanism claim survives only if the learned arm significantly improves hidden recovery-branch semantic preservation at equal budget and the gain replicates on the second API family.

The deterministic isomorphic P/E/X baseline again achieved 12/12 exact final-state plus recovery semantics. Both read-only and state-changing E layers are at ceiling, firing STOP_STATEFUL_DETERMINISTIC_PEX_CEILING; the learned arm is not run and E-3 awaits human DROP/merge review.

title.zh: 固定上限下的干预式权限重授权筛选
title.en: Interventional Permission Triage Under a Fixed Ceiling

problem.zh: 在代理更新后，全量重授权成本高昂，而声明式差异可能遗漏那些表面未变但可达行为已改变的权限。目标是在绝不扩大现有权限上限的前提下，减少重授权工作量。
problem.en: After an agent update, full reauthorization is costly, while declared diffs can miss permissions whose reachable behavior changed despite an unchanged surface. The goal is to reduce reauthorization work without ever expanding the existing authority ceiling.

hypothesis.zh: 在固定上限下，一个冻结的、执行相关的学习筛选租约，相比资源相同的确定性迁移包络租约，能在未见过的突变算子上显著减少每版本重授权数量，且不增加未授权实现效果；这是一个效率主张，而非声称确定性包络无法表达相同的划分。
hypothesis.en: A frozen, execution-relevant learned triage lease materially reduces per-version reauthorization on unseen mutation operators compared with an equally resourced deterministic transition-envelope lease, without increasing unauthorized realized effects; this is an efficiency claim under a fixed ceiling, not a claim that the deterministic envelope cannot express the same partition.

mechanism.zh: 对每个代理突变，计算提示、记忆、技能、工作流和依赖的结构化差异，并为每个既有授权生成差异-权限特征。在训练环境中，随机启用、禁用或限制单个权限，同时运行生成与评分均独立于风险模型的任务和金丝雀；这些干预标记该权限在该突变下是否产生新的越权或越上限效果。学习 q(diff, permission)，即新诱发风险的概率。部署时，首先强制执行不可变的效果上限；所有新请求的权限遵循普通授权流程。对于仍在上限内的既有授权，仅当 q 超过保守阈值时，才将其标记为需金丝雀重授权，且在该授权被清除前禁止执行。未被选中的授权最多保留原有权限，绝不可升级。筛选决策被持久化到下一版本的租约状态中，并在执行时冻结。
mechanism.en: For each agent mutation, compute structured diffs over prompt, memory, skills, workflows, and dependencies and form diff-permission features for every existing grant. In training environments, randomly enable, disable, or restrict individual permissions while running tasks and canaries whose generation and scoring are independent of the risk model; these interventions label whether the permission creates a newly unauthorized or out-of-ceiling effect under that mutation. Learn q(diff, permission), the probability of newly induced risk. At deployment, first enforce an immutable effect ceiling; all newly requested authority follows ordinary authorization. Among existing grants still within the ceiling, only permissions whose q exceeds a conservative threshold are marked for canary reauthorization and cannot execute until cleared. Unselected grants can at most retain prior authority and can never be upgraded. The triage decision is persisted in the next version's lease state and frozen for execution.

method_logic.zh: 两个分支均强制执行不可变效果上限，并将新请求的权限路由至普通授权。对于上限内的既有授权，学习分支仅对冻结 q 超过保守阈值的权限进行重授权；确定性分支仅对声明清单、可达效果集或依赖图发生变化的权限进行重授权。两个分支的选中子集均被持久化到租约中并在执行时冻结。
method_logic.en: Both arms enforce the immutable effect ceiling and route newly requested authority through ordinary authorization. For existing grants within the ceiling, the learned arm reauthorizes only permissions whose frozen q exceeds a conservative threshold; the deterministic arm reauthorizes only permissions whose declared manifest, reachable-effect set, or dependency graph changed. The selected subset is persisted in the lease and frozen for execution in both arms.

novelty_boundary.zh: Progent 在工具调用时执行确定性的符号化最小权限控制，而非突变条件下的重授权筛选。信息流控制方法在运行时执行确定性的信息流策略，而非更新后的授权筛选。AuthBench 关注权限边界推断和授权分解，而非更新后的授权租约筛选。
novelty_boundary.en: Progent enforces deterministic symbolic least-privilege at tool-call time, not mutation-conditioned reauthorization triage. Information-flow control methods enforce deterministic runtime policies, not post-update grant triage. AuthBench addresses permission-boundary inference and authorization decomposition, not post-update lease triage.

strongest_baseline.zh: 确定性固定上限迁移包络/租约筛选：仅对声明清单、可达效果集或依赖图发生变化的权限进行重授权，使用相同的突变表示、金丝雀、标签、调用次数和预算；同时以 Progent 式动态策略和全量重授权作为参考。
strongest_baseline.en: Deterministic fixed-ceiling transition-envelope/lease triage that reauthorizes only permissions whose declared manifest, reachable-effect set, or dependency graph changed, using identical mutation representation, canaries, labels, calls, and budget; Progent-style dynamic policies and full reauthorization serve as references.

minimum_falsifier.zh: 在公开的代理/工具沙箱中，使用训练突变算子从随机化权限干预中训练 q；在完全未见过的测试算子（语义等价提示重写、记忆注入、技能实现替换、间接依赖变更）上评估。交叉设计 {筛选机制} × {突变算子族}，所有方法使用相同的突变表示、金丝雀、标签、调用次数和重授权预算。主要终点：每版本需重授权的权限/金丝雀数量；安全约束：零未授权实现效果，或不超过预注册的全量重授权上限，由独立测试平台裁定。
minimum_falsifier.en: In a public agent/tool sandbox, train q from randomized permission interventions on training mutation operators; test on completely unseen operators (semantically equivalent prompt rewrites, memory injections, skill implementation swaps, indirect dependency changes). Cross {triage mechanism} × {mutation-operator family} with identical mutation representation, canaries, labels, calls, and reauthorization budget. Primary endpoint: permissions/canaries reauthorized per version; safety constraint: zero unauthorized realized effects or no increase beyond the preregistered full-reauthorization bound, adjudicated by the independent harness.

decision_reason.zh: E-4 executable permission CPU P0 已收口：在 train/test mutation feature combinations 0 重叠的 32 个 unseen operators 上，线性 q 虽以 0 missed-risk 将重授权从 deterministic envelope 的 72 降到 53，但同一 mutation representation + 同一 intervention labels 的 monotone-DNF 简单规则同样 0 missed-risk，只需 29 次重授权。触发 STOP_MATCHED_BOOLEAN_RULE_EQUIVALENT；learned q 独立机制不再保留，等待人工 DROP/merge。
decision_reason.en: E-4 executable-permission CPU P0 is closed: on 32 unseen operators with zero overlap between train and test mutation feature combinations, the linear q reduces reauthorizations from 72 for the deterministic envelope to 53 at zero missed risk, but a monotone-DNF simplification induced from the identical mutation representation and intervention labels also has zero missed risk and needs only 29 reauthorizations. STOP_MATCHED_BOOLEAN_RULE_EQUIVALENT fires; the learned-q mechanism is not retained as a standalone method and awaits human DROP/merge review.

novelty_boundary.zh: The proposed assumption break is absorbed before a new experiment is needed. The formal memory paper's monotonicity/self-containment assumptions are idealized properties of its generation operator, and the same paper explicitly records the relevant limitation: real extraction is at best locally monotone and a conflicting claim can overturn earlier conclusions. MindMemOS dreaming does not supply a semantics-blind deletion treatment; it merges redundant records and resolves conflicts, while the observed roughly 20% active-memory reduction is a post-consolidation outcome. The existing principle-certified MindMemOS closure independently verifies that, on FactConsolidation, accuracy gains with lower active-memory volume are predicted by conflict-aware selective forgetting/belief revision when duplicate, stale, or contradictory evidence is consolidated. Therefore the two primary results do not identify an independent ASSUMPTION_BREAK or a new capacity-utility primitive under the same information.

novelty_boundary.zh: The reported bootstrap contrast does not hold generation information and computation responsibility fixed. In the released author implementation, unguided logical generation requires the LLM itself to emit a complete hidden solution plus constraints and the repository only validates that object. Skill-guided generation instead asks the LLM for a semantic blueprint, after which package-specific compiler resources sample the hidden solution, construct true clues, render the puzzle, and verify uniqueness. The initial skill library is itself constructed from domain-level task formats and verifier interfaces and contains reusable construction/compiler resources. Therefore the observed valid-task-yield recovery is already predicted by ordinary model-scaffold compatibility, structured program synthesis, rejection-yield/curriculum coverage, and recursive self-training-collapse accounts when one arm offloads constraint construction to deterministic scaffolding. The current evidence cannot identify an additional self-evolution reproduction threshold beyond those mature objects.

novelty_boundary.zh: The two ablations remove different ordinary resources. Uniform routing weakens query/task-conditioned curriculum allocation while retaining the evolving skill mechanism; Frozen skills holds the available skill library fixed while retaining skill-guided generation. Large marginal drops from weakening allocation and from weakening the available expert/curriculum set are both predicted by standard expert-set quality plus gating/allocation decompositions and do not identify an interaction term. The same paper's policy co-evolution ablation is consistent with this interpretation: Frozen proposer causes a 2.1-point drop, Frozen feedback solver a 3.0-point drop, and Frozen both a 3.2-point drop, which is not evidence of a super-additive co-evolution cliff and is compatible with overlapping/complementary resources.

novelty_boundary.zh: SkillCoach already provides a matched positive explanation for the scoped boundary. Section 4.4 freezes the agent and removes tool execution, environment failures, and verifier noise so the experiment is a pure candidate-selection stress test. At fixed library size (50 distractors), changing only distractor semantic type causes large F1 changes: high-similarity distractors are substantially more damaging than random unrelated distractors. Across the size sweep, stronger frozen selectors degrade later and may remain outside collapse through 50k, whereas weaker selectors cross collapse earlier. novelty_boundary.zh: The released AutoDesign loop repeatedly evaluates candidate harnesses on a fixed development set, maps the result into an accept/reject decision, stores that acceptance decision in the persistent optimization record, and gives the updated record to the optimizer in the next iteration. Raw dev scores are hidden, but the acceptance bit is still an adaptive function of the fixed dev set. This is a direct instance of adaptive validation/reusable-held-out feedback rather than a new causal primitive. The same reduction also applies to recursive keep-better schemes such as RSEA, where successive candidate states are repeatedly selected using the same held-out validation split.

novelty_boundary.zh: The two ablations remove different ordinary resources and therefore do not identify an interaction. ERSkill's w/o-skill-evolution condition freezes the expert/action space at three seed retrieval skills, while w/o-router retains the skill system but replaces the trained query-dependent router with LLM-based skill selection. A large drop from reducing the available expert set and a large drop from degrading expert selection are both predicted by standard representation/action-set plus gating/routing decompositions. They do not imply a nonseparable co-evolution cliff. The paper's own evolution case study further reports that routed deploy accuracy can temporarily fall when higher-coverage skills replace older skills before the router adapts, then recover after subsequent router updates, which is the expected lag of a selector adapting to a changing expert set rather than evidence for a new causal primitive.

novelty_boundary.zh: The weak-metric observation does not isolate invariance to evaluator quality because the binary pass/fail metric is not the only training signal. The source explicitly states that a failed attempt still contributes concrete error text to skill synthesis, so label degradation is compensated by a richer feedback channel. This is ordinary information redundancy/multi-channel supervision: corrupting one channel need not reduce learning when another channel preserves error-localizing information. Separately, the distinction between task score and metric validity is already the source paper's central evaluation claim and protocol: metric validity is measured against a locked reference that metric evolution never reads, while task score is used only for downstream sufficiency. Recasting that same distinction as a new problem would be a direct current-source collision rather than unexplained negative space.

novelty_boundary.zh: GeoForge itself attributes the sensitivity curve to the ordinary quality-coverage trade-off of retrieved guidance: a small number of high-quality skills performs best, excessive retrieval slightly degrades trajectory quality because guidance becomes redundant, and an overly strict score threshold hurts Tool-Exact-Match by filtering useful experiences. This is exactly the prediction of marginal-information/complementarity-versus-redundancy models under a finite context/action-planning budget. The system's own mature reduction ledger likewise treats sharing-helpful versus sharing-collapse behavior as information redundancy/correlation or diversity-consensus trade-off unless a same-information residual survives.

novelty_boundary.zh: The same primary source already identifies why the closed loop can repair cases that prompt-only rewriting cannot. ComfyClaw changes the available intervention surface: its graph interface can revise both text and the executable pipeline, including LoRA insertion/weights, regional attention and masks, sampler/guidance parameters, graph topology, and multi-pass refinement. Across 35,612 workflow events, only 39.3% are prompt-text edits and 60.7% operate on those non-prompt surfaces. The verifier additionally supplies localized failure descriptions and concrete workflow edits; the source's qualitative trajectories show those suggestions triggering structural repairs and a best-so-far buffer protecting against non-monotone retries. Thus the prompt-only gap is source-internally explained by a strictly larger action/intervention space plus localized feedback control, not left as unexplained negative space.

title.zh: 决策翻转驱动的转移准入

problem.zh: AAWM 已经把 world-model supervision 改成 policy decision needs，因此不能再主张‘decision-aware world model target’。剩下的问题是更新预算：真实 transition 很多时，哪些 transition 值得被持久写入/训练，才能以更少更新改变后续决策。
problem.en: AAWM already makes world-model supervision decision-oriented, so 'decision-aware world-model targets' are no longer enough. The remaining problem is update budgeting: among many real transitions, which ones deserve persistent storage/training because correcting them would change later decisions?

hypothesis.zh: 决策价值门控应以更少更新获得同等或更高任务收益。
hypothesis.en: Decision-value gating should match or improve utility with fewer updates.

mechanism.zh: 对每条真实 transition 先计算当前 world model 的预测；再做 counterfactual decision test：把该 transition 的预测替换成真实 next state/关键属性，重新求一次当前 policy 的 action/risk/recovery decision。只有 correction 会导致 action switch、risk threshold crossing 或 recovery choice 改变的 transition 才进入固定容量的持久 transition memory/adapter 更新。
mechanism.en: For each real transition, compare the current world-model prediction with truth, then run a counterfactual decision test: replace only that prediction with the true next state/critical attributes and recompute the current policy's action/risk/recovery decision. Admit the transition to fixed-capacity persistent memory/adapter training only if the correction causes an action switch, risk-threshold crossing, or recovery-choice change.

method_logic.zh: 0) 先确认持续适应场景真实存在；1) 冻结 policy/world-model snapshot；2) 收集真实 transition 与预测；3) 对每条 transition 做 one-factor prediction→truth replacement；4) 标 action/risk/recovery decision switch；5) 固定 update budget 下训练 transition memory/adapter；6) 测试时冻结 gate 与 updater；7) 第二环境/模型前再冻结一次。
method_logic.en: 0) First confirm the continual-adaptation setting is real; 1) freeze policy/world-model snapshots; 2) collect real transitions and predictions; 3) replace one transition prediction with truth at a time; 4) label action/risk/recovery decision switches; 5) train transition memory/adapter under a fixed update budget; 6) freeze gate/updater at test time; 7) freeze again before a second environment/model.

novelty_boundary.zh: AAWM 已直接用 policy decision needs 构造 world-model supervision，因此 F-1 不再主张 decision-aware target。只保留 fixed update budget 下的 decision-switch transition selection。
novelty_boundary.en: AAWM directly constructs world-model supervision from policy decision needs, so F-1 no longer claims decision-aware targets. The surviving variable is decision-switch transition selection under a fixed update budget.

strongest_baseline.zh: Learn-all, residual-magnitude top-k, random equal-count, value-aware/CVAML-style weighting, and same-data direct action-disagreement selection.
strongest_baseline.en: Learn-all, residual-magnitude top-k, random equal-count, value-aware/CVAML-style weighting, and same-data direct action-disagreement selection.

minimum_falsifier.zh: Freeze a small world model+policy, collect >=100 transition errors with disjoint hidden state regions, update only the adapter, and use <=50% of learn-all transitions.
minimum_falsifier.en: Freeze a small world model+policy, collect >=100 transition errors with disjoint hidden state regions, update only the adapter, and use <=50% of learn-all transitions.

decision_reason.zh: 严格服从人工 gate：需先与子龙确认 real continual-adaptation scenario、重做 novelty audit、精确定义 persistent update object；当前 repo 仅有 scenario-check，无确认记录。

reopen_condition.en: Merge F-1 admission into direct action-disagreement/value-aware selection.

title.zh: 可验证不可逆效应条款记忆

problem.zh: test-time counterfactual planning、act/refuse safety 和 recovery 已经有大量工作；真正可能形成持续学习的是把少量可验证的‘状态条件 + 动作 → 不可逆效应’编译成跨 episode 复用的条款，从而后续无需重复模拟就能提前排除风险动作。
problem.en: Test-time counterfactual planning, act/refuse safety, and recovery already have substantial prior work. A plausible persistent-learning problem is compiling a small set of verified 'state condition + action → irreversible effect' clauses that can be reused across episodes to prune risky actions without repeated simulation.

hypothesis.zh: 验证后的反事实记忆应减少不可逆错误且不导致过度保守。
hypothesis.en: Verified counterfactual memory should reduce irreversible errors without excessive conservatism.

mechanism.zh: 只在有 simulator/程序规则可验证的环境生成未执行 action counterfactual。若某动作跨越预定义的不可逆 state-equivalence boundary（例如资源永久耗尽、关键对象销毁、权限不可恢复改变），把最小 precondition + action + verified effect 编译成 typed risk clause。后续 episode 先查 clause，再决定是否需要 planner。
mechanism.en: Generate unexecuted-action counterfactuals only where a simulator/program rule can verify them. If an action crosses a predefined irreversible state-equivalence boundary (permanent resource depletion, destruction of a key object, non-recoverable permission change), compile the minimal precondition + action + verified effect into a typed risk clause. Later episodes consult clauses before invoking a planner.

method_logic.zh: 1) 预定义可程序判定的 irreversible state predicates；2) source states 生成少量 candidate unexecuted actions；3) simulator/program verifier 判 effect；4) delta-minimize precondition；5) 编译 typed clause；6) hidden episode 中 clause 先 prune，再允许普通 planner 处理剩余动作；7) clause learner 测试前冻结。
method_logic.en: 1) Predefine program-checkable irreversible state predicates; 2) generate a few candidate unexecuted actions on source states; 3) verify effects with simulator/program truth; 4) delta-minimize preconditions; 5) compile typed clauses; 6) in hidden episodes use clauses to prune before the ordinary planner handles remaining actions; 7) freeze the clause learner before testing.

novelty_boundary.zh: MOSAIC 已学习 act/refuse，EvoCF 已做 evolutionary counterfactual planning，Human-Guided Harm Recovery 也覆盖后果恢复。因此只保留 verified counterfactual effect → persistent reusable irreversibility clause，而不是 test-time planning/safety。
novelty_boundary.en: MOSAIC learns act/refuse decisions, EvoCF performs evolutionary counterfactual planning, and Human-Guided Harm Recovery covers aftermath recovery. The surviving claim is verified counterfactual effect → persistent reusable irreversibility clause, not test-time planning/safety.

strongest_baseline.zh: Same-label capacity-matched direct risk classifier/shield, hand irreversible mask, and nearest failed-trajectory memory with equal simulator calls and runtime checks.
strongest_baseline.en: Same-label capacity-matched direct risk classifier/shield, hand irreversible mask, and nearest failed-trajectory memory with equal simulator calls and runtime checks.

minimum_falsifier.zh: Use >=40 irreversible failures + 20 matched safe cases held out by topology; freeze clauses and run simulator-off measuring unsafe entries, false blocks, success, and cost.
minimum_falsifier.en: Use >=40 irreversible failures + 20 matched safe cases held out by topology; freeze clauses and run simulator-off measuring unsafe entries, false blocks, success, and cost.

title.zh: 残余状态效应驱动的经验准入

problem.zh: 最终任务成功是一个很粗的标签：它会把‘干净完成’和‘勉强补救后完成’都记成 success。长期自进化却会把成功轨迹写成可复用经验；如果补救轨迹虽然完成目标，却仍留下抽屉未复位、工具被占用、权限/资源状态异常等残余状态，反复学习就可能把这些异常行为固化。真正要验证的问题是：这类 success+残余状态是否会被误写成正经验，并在未来复用时造成伤害。
problem.en: Final task success is a coarse label: it treats clean completion and barely recovered completion as the same success. Long-term self-evolution may persist successful trajectories as reusable experience; if a recovered trajectory completes the goal but leaves residual state such as an unrestored drawer, occupied tool, or abnormal permission/resource state, repeated learning may entrench that behavior. The concrete question is whether success-with-residual-state is admitted as positive experience and later causes harm when reused.

hypothesis.zh: 若残余状态真的影响未来复用，基于 Δs 学到的准入应在相同记忆容量和 replay 预算下，比 success-only、终点相同和手工恢复阈值更少产生负迁移。
hypothesis.en: If residual state truly matters for future reuse, Δs-based learned admission should reduce negative transfer versus success-only, endpoint-equality, and hand-coded recovery thresholds under the same memory and replay budgets.

mechanism.zh: 先做 P0a 现象门：同起点配对正常成功与扰动后成功轨迹，读取 exact program state，计算对象位置、持有物、开关/权限/资源等 residual vector Δs，并审计 baseline writer 是否正向写入。只有发生率足够才做 P0b：用未来 matched reuse harm 监督 residual-effect admission score，决定 write/summarize/quarantine。
mechanism.en: First run a P0a phenomenon gate: pair normal and perturbed-success trajectories from the same start, read exact program state, compute a residual vector Δs over object locations, inventory, switches/permissions/resources, and audit whether a baseline writer stores them positively. Only if prevalence is sufficient run P0b: supervise a residual-effect admission score with future matched-reuse harm to choose write/summarize/quarantine.

method_logic.zh: P0a: 1) exact-state 环境；2) 同起点 normal/perturbed success 配对；3) 重汇合点/终点算 typed Δs；4) 审计 success-only writer；5) prevalence 不足立即停。P0b: 6) 对已写经验做 future memory OFF/ON matched reuse；7) 以真实 harm 监督 residual-effect score；8) 与 endpoint equality/手工 threshold 匹配 replay 比较。
method_logic.en: P0a: 1) exact-state environment; 2) pair same-start normal/perturbed successes; 3) compute typed Δs at rejoin/endpoints; 4) audit a success-only writer; 5) stop immediately if prevalence is low. P0b: 6) run future memory OFF/ON matched reuse for stored experiences; 7) supervise a residual-effect score with true harm; 8) compare with endpoint equality/hand thresholds at matched replay.

novelty_boundary.zh: Dejavu/trajectory-memory methods 已从恢复轨迹生成经验，Human-Guided Harm Recovery 也直接研究 recovery。因此只保留 success-only writer 对 success+nonzero Δs 的误准入及其未来 reuse harm。

novelty_boundary.zh: A DRC rule label is not a matched repair state. EvoDRC's released Block7 traces show that the residual occurs despite continuing knowledge updates and despite the violations being included in repair units. More importantly, the first-party proposals expose direct feasibility and constraint-coupling witnesses. In iter4, an M1.S.2 case has a 252-dbu notch while the via M1 land plus two required 100-dbu clearances needs 272 dbu, so a simple placement satisfying both sides is geometrically impossible without merging geometry or creating another violation. In iter5, one V1/M1 repair explicitly accepts a declared-debt M1.S.2 violation, another plan that would clear 117 target violations is deferred because it would introduce more than 110 new violations, and the contested-unit DRC gate rejects a candidate with delta_total=+64. Thus the cross-block persistence is positively explained by changed feasible-action support and coupled-constraint repair debt rather than by evidence that the same executable skill failed to transfer to an otherwise matched state.

novelty_boundary.zh: The two ablations remove ordinary information resources rather than isolating a new self-evolution primitive. Layout images and cropped sub-images supply task-relevant visual evidence for figures, charts, and spatial document structure; removing them directly reduces observability/evidence sufficiency. Tree annotations are part of DocAtlas's mutable search/index representation and alter the information available to later retrieval; removing them degrades All-Hit and page-F1 as expected when an index/search state loses structured navigation signals. These effects are fully expressible by information availability, retrieval/index quality, and observability baselines unless information content and query budget are matched while only the evolving representation changes.

novelty_boundary.zh: The reported TRS>=0.6 failure cases are already explained in the primary paper as base-model visual-grounding errors rather than incompatible or non-executable procedure memories. In the cited cases both the no-memory baseline and SMA fail, the retrieved memories are described as high-quality and semantically relevant, the response attempts to apply the procedure, and the remaining error is misreading movement direction, object count, or spatial connectivity. The observed high-relevance-plus-failure pattern therefore does not identify an additional memory-conflict mechanism.

problem.zh: The hazard function λ(s) = lim_{dt→0} P(T ∈ [t, t+dt) | T ≥ t, S_t = s) where T is the first-safety-violation time under a fixed benign future update distribution, and S_t is the persistent agent state (experience bank + skill library) at time t, restricted to states that currently pass a frozen safety evaluation. The scientific object is whether λ varies as a function of the specific persistent state identity beyond what is predictable from current safety score, update count, pool size, and distribution-shift statistics.

hypothesis.en: Among persistent agent states that all currently pass the frozen BrowserART safety evaluation and are matched on current safety score, update count, experience amount, pool size, and distribution-shift metrics, the first-safety-violation survival function under a fixed benign future update distribution will differ significantly (log-rank test p < 0.05) between states with different update histories.

mechanism.zh: History-conditioned first-violation hazard after persistent state evolution
mechanism.en: History-conditioned first-violation hazard after persistent state evolution

method_logic.zh: Use the released AWM framework and BrowserART environment to generate multiple persistent states via different benign update sequences. Select states that all pass a frozen safety evaluation and match them on current safety score, update count, experience amount, pool size, and distribution-shift metrics. For each matched state, spawn multiple reproducible benign future branches (horizon 3/5 updates). After each update, evaluate safety with frozen probes. Compare first-violation survival curves using log-rank test. STOP if static/current-state baselines explain the future hazard or branch outcomes are not reproducible.

novelty_boundary.zh: Under the frozen five-arm same-information F0, ECHO_EXTRACTIVE increases unanswerable false answering by only 3.125 percentage points over both RAW_ONLY and TOKEN_MATCHED_NEUTRAL, with exact paired p=0.6875 in both comparisons. novelty_boundary.zh: There is no cross-level sign reversal in the scaling treatment effect once each scaled condition is compared with its matched unscaled baseline. At the VLA level, MG-Select changes success from 23.25 to 21.38 (-1.87 points) and VOTE from 23.25 to 22.00 (-1.25). At the Seed-Agent level, MG-Select changes 28.25 to 24.38 (-3.87) and VOTE changes 28.25 to 23.50 (-4.75). The apparent reversal arises only by comparing the scaled Seed-Agent conditions against the lower direct-VLA baseline, thereby mixing the positive effect of introducing the Seed-Agent scaffold with the negative marginal effect of scaling.

novelty_boundary.zh: The reported sign reversal is predicted by ordinary task-conditioned negative transfer followed by error-driven corrective skill optimization. MindMemOS's initial xlsx skill is a generic procedural artifact with sparse cautions and is worse than No-skill on SpreadsheetBench. Its unsupervised evolution turns recurring execution failures into concrete error-avoidance rules, while supervised evolution uses task scores to bound those rules and avoid overgeneralization, e.g. preserving requested formulas rather than hard-coding values merely to satisfy cached-value checks. SkillGrad independently reports the same qualitative object on SpreadsheetBench Verified across two backbones and two skill initializations: base xlsx skills can underperform No-skill, and failed plus contrastive-success trajectories are used as corrective evidence to patch the same skill into a higher-performing artifact. Therefore the negative-to-positive transition does not require an additional self-evolution primitive beyond skill-task misalignment, corrective learning, and rule specialization/applicability learning.

novelty_boundary.zh: EvoDRC's released logs show a real label mismatch, but the mismatch is already explained by the distinction between feasibility/admissibility and causal utility credit. Across 24 released units with both an independent local DRC score and a gate verdict, all 24 pass the connectivity gate while 10/24 are locally net worse; seven of those locally harmful units occur in globally improving iterations. Existing causal-utility admission principles already require persistent artifacts to be credited from matched downstream effect rather than feasibility, acceptance, or shared aggregate success.

novelty_boundary.zh: The claimed assumption break compares different scientific quantities. arXiv:2608.11654 defines memory as an event subset whose generation operator produces a knowledge span, and its monotonicity assumption is a structural assumption about coverage/answerability under set inclusion. The same paper explicitly separates coverage from correctness and states that the assumptions hold only approximately in practice: real extraction is at best locally monotone and a conflicting claim can overturn earlier conclusions, including previously correct coverage. arXiv:2608.11888 instead measures end-to-end execution correctness and cost under paired skill/no-skill or matched-skill configurations. Its dominant functional failures are Task-Implementation Faults, and the paper attributes them to topically relevant reusable defaults/examples/templates that conflict with or incompletely cover task-required fields, APIs, paths, output formats, domain rules, or environment constraints. Thus the skill-harm result is real but does not falsify the formal set-coverage assumption: it changes execution utility on a different causal/measurement surface, while the formal source already records conflict-driven non-monotonic practical behavior. The remaining failure is expressible by task-skill compatibility/negative transfer plus the coverage-versus-correctness distinction without a new procedural-memory retraction primitive.

novelty_boundary.zh: The reported GPT-5.5 behavior is already represented by the paper's own multiobjective runtime-defense formulation and by ordinary overblocking/conservative-policy trade-offs. HARD defines the defense objective in terms of security and utility, explicitly notes that overly restrictive interventions can improve security at the cost of legitimate capability, and interprets different HARD variants as different operating points on a security-utility frontier. In the backbone ablation the execution agent, judges, tasks, evolution rounds, and budget are fixed while the evolution backbone changes; the resulting policies occupy different ASR/BU/UA points. The GPT-5.5 point (ASR 20.3, BU 94.9, UA 7.2) therefore demonstrates a poor utility-conditioned operating point, not an additional causal primitive or an identified phase transition.

evidence.zh: B-8 standalone 已停止升级，clean R1 不授权。旧共享 P0 仍是 SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT_METHOD_INCONCLUSIVE + PROVENANCE_INCONCLUSIVE，不得改写成旧方法 FAIL。后续 CPU-only failure diagnosis 解释了“为什么原理看起来成立但 gate 学不出来”：retrieved vs token-matched placebo 的 first-divergence 在 nonzero effect 中显著更早；同物理 RTX3090 regeneration 对 11 个原 nonzero unit 的首分叉位置 11/11 复现、具体首分叉 action pair 10/11 复现，排除了纯随机噪声。但 state-signature localization 很弱（相对最佳 task baseline Brier 仅改善 3.46%，MI permutation p=0.216）；同一 memory se-m-pick_cool_then_place_in_recep-1 在完全相同的 index-0 pre_acquire|navigate>navigate signature 下对 cool/heat/clean target 分别产生 -1/+1/-1。当前最符合的解释是：memory 稳定地改变早期 trajectory branch，但最终 benefit/harm sign 由 downstream context 放大决定；因此 candidate-global replicated-effect 假设过强。该诊断不复活 B-8，也不自动授权替代 idea。 工程上仅保留为 soft audit-priority signal：1-step 约 25% paired-rollout 成本可覆盖 54.5% nonzero effects，但达到 90.9% recall 时 5-step 成本已约 90.1%；因此只能用于审计排序，禁止作为 hard gate 淘汰 confirmatory cases。
evidence.en: Standalone B-8 escalation is stopped and a clean R1 is not authorized. The old shared P0 remains SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT_METHOD_INCONCLUSIVE plus PROVENANCE_INCONCLUSIVE and must not be rewritten as an old-method FAIL. A later CPU-only failure diagnosis explains why the principle can look right while the gate remains unlearnable: retrieved versus token-matched placebo diverges significantly earlier on nonzero-effect units. On matched physical RTX3090 regeneration, the first-divergence index reproduces for 11/11 original nonzero units and the exact first-divergent action pair for 10/11, ruling out pure stochastic noise. Yet state-signature localization is weak (only 3.46% Brier improvement over the best task baseline; MI permutation p=0.216). The same memory se-m-pick_cool_then_place_in_recep-1 yields -1/+1/-1 on cool/heat/clean targets under the identical index-0 pre_acquire|navigate>navigate signature. The best current explanation is reproducible early trajectory-branch steering whose downstream context determines benefit versus harm, so the candidate-global replicated-effect assumption was too strong. This diagnosis does not revive B-8 or auto-authorize a replacement idea. Operationally, retain this only as a soft audit-priority signal: a 1-step screen uses about 25% of paired-rollout cost and captures 54.5% of nonzero effects, but reaching 90.9% recall at 5 steps already costs about 90.1%. It may prioritize audit order but must never hard-exclude confirmatory cases.
